pieces.name: Leather Headgear
pieces.desc:
Headgear made from tanned
monster hide. Sturdy and
suitable for anyone to use.

pieces.name: Leather Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from
leather and other light,
easily obtainable materials.

pieces.name: Leather Gloves
pieces.desc:
Gloves crafted from leather
and other light materials.
Made to be easy to use.

pieces.name: Leather Belt
pieces.desc:
A belt made from leather
and other light materials.
Basic general equipment.

pieces.name: Leather Trousers
pieces.desc:
Leg armor preferred as basic
hunter equipment. Light and
easy to move in.

pieces.name: Chainmail Headgear
pieces.desc:
Sturdy head armor made from
quality ore. Reliable mail that
has protected countless hunters.

pieces.name: Chainmail Vest
pieces.desc:
Sturdy chest armor made of
chainmail. Responsible for
saving many a hunter's life.

pieces.name: Chainmail Gloves
pieces.desc:
Sturdy gloves made of
chainmail. Popular and
easy to maintain.

pieces.name: Chainmail Belt
pieces.desc:
Sturdy waist armor crafted
with a special process. Thin
and light on the hips.

pieces.name: Chainmail Trousers
pieces.desc:
Sturdy leg armor. Made with
as little metal as possible,
so as to be easy to wear.

pieces.name: Bherna Turban
pieces.desc:
Bherna headgear that
offers solid protection
against strong winds.

pieces.name: Bherna Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor with a
Moofah fur hood adorned
with Bherna's crest.

pieces.name: Bherna Braces
pieces.desc:
Guards carefully crafted
from leather. Sturdy yet
versatile.

pieces.name: Bherna Belt
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted from
clothing for ranch hands.
Popular with travelers.

pieces.name: Bherna Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor for Bherna
Hunters. Can endure even
the harshest of conditions.

pieces.name: Hunting Helm
pieces.desc:
Kokoto headgear. Many
hunters love its simple
and pure design.

pieces.name: Hunting Mail
pieces.desc:
Kokoto chest armor.
Simple, yet packed with
features for hunters.

pieces.name: Hunting Braces
pieces.desc:
Guards made using ancient
wisdom and materials
commonly found in Kokoto.

pieces.name: Hunting Faulds
pieces.desc:
Strong and simple waist
armor. Uses materials
commonly found in Kokoto.

pieces.name: Hunting Greaves
pieces.desc:
Basic leg armor from
Kokoto. Has long kept
young Blademasters safe.

pieces.name: Hunting Cap
pieces.desc:
Common Kokoto headgear.
A favorite of the area's
young Gunners.

pieces.name: Hunting Vest
pieces.desc:
Made from materials
native to Kokoto.
Simple, yet effective.

pieces.name: Hunting Guards
pieces.desc:
Guards made using ancient
wisdom and materials
commonly found in Kokoto.

pieces.name: Hunting Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor that has been
loved by Kokoto hunters
for many, many years.

pieces.name: Hunting Leggings
pieces.desc:
Kokoto leg armor. Made
light by removing any
ornate decorations.

pieces.name: Mafumofu Hood
pieces.desc:
A special product of Pokke.
Helps protect from the intense
cold of the mountains.

pieces.name: Mafumofu Jacket
pieces.desc:
A special product of Pokke.
The fluffy feeling makes you
want to wear it everywhere.

pieces.name: Mafumofu Mittens
pieces.desc:
A special product of Pokke.
These thick mittens are
famed for their ease of use.

pieces.name: Mafumofu Coat
pieces.desc:
A special product of Pokke.
Makes it feel like it's 72
degrees--all the time.

pieces.name: Mafumofu Boots
pieces.desc:
A special product of Pokke.
Retains heat and allows for
easy movement in the snow.

pieces.name: Yukumo Kasa
pieces.desc:
Headgear from the Yukumo region.
It identifies the wearer as a
traveling hunter.

pieces.name: Yukumo Dogi
pieces.desc:
Chest armor common among the
people of the Yukumo region, it
stresses mobility over Defense.

pieces.name: Yukumo Kote
pieces.desc:
Armguards from the Yukumo
region. Worn by rangers,
hunters, and travelers all.

pieces.name: Yukumo Obi
pieces.desc:
Functional waist armor designed
for convenience. Often wrapped
around the shoulders for warmth.

pieces.name: Yukumo Hakama
pieces.desc:
Leg armor worn all over the
Yukumo region. One can alter
the hem width using the sash.

pieces.name: Loc Lac Shawl
pieces.desc:
Armor often worn in the
desert. Designed to absorb
sweat and dissipate heat.

pieces.name: Loc Lac Kilt
pieces.desc:
Desert waist armor. Widely
used for its reliable heat-
resistant properties.

pieces.name: Loc Lac Boots
pieces.desc:
Boots made for the desert.
Maximum heat-resistance in
a minimal package.

pieces.name: Hunter's Helm
Hunter's Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made especially
for hunters. Common equipment
worn by many.

pieces.name: Hunter's Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Arm equipment made for hunters.
Sturdy and yet still extremely
maneuverable.

pieces.name: Hunter's Faulds
Hunter's Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made especially
for hunters. Stout equipment
made for maneuverability.

pieces.name: Hunter's Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made especially
for hunters. Equipped with
a scope in the eye area.

pieces.name: Hunter's Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made especially
for hunters. Famous for its
large throat protector.

pieces.name: Hunter's Guards
pieces.desc:
Arm equipment made for hunters.
Solid all-purpose gear with no
major deficiencies.

pieces.name: Hunter's Coat
Hunter's Leggings
Bone Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor fashioned from
monster bones. It smells
as wild as it looks.

pieces.name: Bone Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from
monster bones. Evocative
of the natural world.

pieces.name: Bone Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Arm equipment crafted from
monster bones. Known for
their distinctive wild look.

pieces.name: Bone Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor adorned with
monster bones. The spines on
its rear are a key feature.

pieces.name: Bone Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor crafted from monster
bones. Provides superb, rugged
leg protection.

pieces.name: Bone Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor that makes
liberal use of monster bone.
Protects when it counts.

pieces.name: Bone Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from
monster bones. Quite practical,
despite its appearance.

pieces.name: Bone Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards decorated with
monster bones. Said to somehow
enhance the five senses.

pieces.name: Bone Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted from
monster bones. Skimpy, but
surprisingly practical.

pieces.name: Bone Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor crafted from
monster bones. The wildness
they give off is palpable.

pieces.name: Light Belt
pieces.desc:
Simple leather belt with
unique crafting. Thin, thus
lightly worn on the waist.

pieces.name: Iron Belt
pieces.desc:
A belt strengthened with Iron
Ore. Stronger than leather,
it covers one's weak points.

pieces.name: Chaoshroom
pieces.desc:
A hat modeled on a chaos-
creating mushroom. Foes may
hallucinate at your feet.

pieces.name: Chaos Plate
pieces.desc:
Brings chaos to foes while
instilling a sense of calm
serenity within its wearer.

pieces.name: Chaos Diadem
pieces.desc:
Modeled after a chaos-
causing mushroom. May plague
foes with hallucinations.

pieces.name: Chaos Brigandine
pieces.desc:
The things it does to your
foe's mind.
Strange armor it is.

pieces.name: Trapper's Gauntlets
pieces.desc:
Gauntlets lined with fur.
Popular with Blademasters
in colder regions.

pieces.name: Trapper's Greaves
pieces.desc:
Made of materials that offer
protection from the cold
and prevent frostbite.

pieces.name: Trapper's Gloves
pieces.desc:
Gunner gloves that are
flexible, but provide good
protection from the cold.

pieces.name: Trapper's Boots
pieces.desc:
Armor that protects in the
cold while offering superb
traction on snow and ice.

pieces.name: Maccao Gauntlets
pieces.desc:
Gauntlets made from the
tanned hide of a Maccao.
Perfect for Blademasters.

pieces.name: Maccao Shinguards
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Maccao
materials. Even non-hunters
enjoy the vivid colors.

pieces.name: Maccao Gloves
pieces.desc:
Maccao gloves that are
perfect for discerning Gunners
who are into fashion.

pieces.name: Maccao Boots
pieces.desc:
Leg armor for Gunners that's
been carefully crafted to be
both light and durable.

pieces.name: Jaggi Gauntlets
pieces.desc:
Made from Great Jaggi
materials. Loved by novice
and veteran hunters alike.

pieces.name: Jaggi Shinguards
pieces.desc:
Made mostly from Great
Jaggi materials. They are
known for their versatility.

pieces.name: Jaggi Gloves
pieces.desc:
Made from Great Jaggi parts.
"May your shots fly straight
and your aim be true."

pieces.name: Jaggi Boots
pieces.desc:
Made from Great Jaggi
materials. Offers support for
a wide range of activities.

pieces.name: Jaggi Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from Jaggi
parts. Inexpensive, but
robust and reliable.

pieces.name: Jaggi Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from Jaggi
parts. The supple skin
makes for good protection.

pieces.name: Jaggi Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Arm equipment made from
Jaggi parts. Designed with
an emphasis on practicality.

pieces.name: Jaggi Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Jaggi
parts. A flamboyant use of
the Jaggi's beautiful skin.

pieces.name: Jaggi Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Jaggi
parts. Crafted for high
maneuverability.

pieces.name: Jaggi Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from Jaggi
parts. Equipped with goggles
to protect Gunners' eyes.

pieces.name: Jaggi Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from Jaggi
parts. The thick skin grants
good protection from shocks.

pieces.name: Jaggi Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from Jaggi
parts. The open fingertips
allow for precise movement.

pieces.name: Jaggi Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Jaggi
parts. The striking pattern
is rather eye-catching.

pieces.name: Jaggi Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Jaggi
parts. Designed to disperse
shocks into the ground.

pieces.name: Maccao Helm
pieces.desc:
Headgear popular with
children, it's also a symbol
of conservationists.

pieces.name: Maccao Mail
pieces.desc:
Worn by conservationists
who have sworn to defend
the kingdom's forests.

pieces.name: Maccao Braces
pieces.desc:
Braces that can provide ease
of movement in even the most
hostile environments.

pieces.name: Maccao Faulds
pieces.desc:
Armor that features bright
green to denote harmony,
and red for justice.

pieces.name: Maccao Greaves
pieces.desc:
Practical yet stylish Great
Maccao armor. Perfect for a
hunt in the deepest forests.

pieces.name: Maccao Cap
pieces.desc:
Based on the cap of a great
hero that helped protect the
forest and its people.

pieces.name: Maccao Vest
pieces.desc:
Protects the bodies and
pride of marksmen that live
amidst nature.

pieces.name: Maccao Guards
pieces.desc:
Made of Great Maccao parts.
Said to have come from the
followers of a great savior.

pieces.name: Maccao Coat
pieces.desc:
Bright yellow and green
waist armor that depicts a
love of mankind and nature.

pieces.name: Maccao Leggings
pieces.desc:
Tough leg armor that
enables hunts in even the
most rugged terrain.

pieces.name: Velociprey Helm
pieces.desc:
Helm crafted from Velociprey
materials. Truly superior
functionality.

pieces.name: Velociprey Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from
Velociprey parts. Extremely
durable and well-balanced.

pieces.name: Velociprey Braces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces made of Velociprey
material. Performance that
lives up to expectations.

pieces.name: Velociprey Tassets
pieces.desc:
Armor made from Velociprey
parts. Masterfully balanced
for close quarters combat.

pieces.name: Velociprey Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made of Velociprey
parts. Protects the entire
leg, not just the shin.

pieces.name: Velociprey Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of fastened
Velociprey parts. Tough enough
to withstand a true pummeling.

pieces.name: Velociprey Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from
Velociprey parts. Quite
practical.

pieces.name: Velociprey Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of fastened
Velociprey parts. Crafted with
emphasis on the shield area.

pieces.name: Velociprey Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted with
easily obtainable Velociprey
materials.

pieces.name: Velociprey Leggings
pieces.desc:
Uses Velociprey material to
protect the wearer's legs.
Made to avoid obstacles.

pieces.name: Giaprey Helm
pieces.desc:
A white helm made from
Giaprey parts. The hallmark
item of a snowlands hunter.

pieces.name: Giaprey Mail
pieces.desc:
Made from Giaprey parts,
this practical armor is a
northern hunter's trademark.

pieces.name: Giaprey Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Snow-white Giaprey vambraces.
As white as they are tough,
they'll keep you warm and safe.

pieces.name: Giaprey Tassets
pieces.desc:
Tassets made from Giaprey
parts. A superior item that
matches ability with beauty.

pieces.name: Giaprey Greaves
pieces.desc:
Greaves made from Giaprey
parts. A beautiful design
optimized for hunting.

pieces.name: Giaprey Cap
pieces.desc:
A cap made from Giaprey
parts that have been sewn
together. A widely traded item.

pieces.name: Giaprey Vest
pieces.desc:
Practical and easy to
obtain, this vest is popular
with northern gunners.

pieces.name: Giaprey Guards
pieces.desc:
Made from Giaprey parts,
their white morning glow is
proof of their excellence.

pieces.name: Giaprey Coat
pieces.desc:
Made from Giaprey parts.
No amount of abrasion can
make it lose its shine.

pieces.name: Giaprey Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings made from Giaprey
parts. The silvery-white
finish is truly beautiful.

pieces.name: Genprey Helm
pieces.desc:
A helm made from the finest
Genprey materials. Sister
to the Velociprey Helm.

pieces.name: Genprey Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made of Genprey
parts. Performance differs
from Velociprey Mail.

pieces.name: Genprey Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from Genprey
materials. Sisters to the
Velociprey Braces.

pieces.name: Genprey Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from
Genprey materials. Sister
to the Velociprey Tassets.

pieces.name: Genprey Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Genprey
materials. Sisters to the
Velociprey Greaves.

pieces.name: Genprey Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of woven
Genprey scales. Utilizes
sophisticated technology.

pieces.name: Genprey Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from
Genprey parts. Known for
its thick metallic breastplate.

pieces.name: Genprey Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made by combining
Genprey materials and ore.
The metallic armoring is of note.

pieces.name: Genprey Coat
pieces.desc:
Armor made from a combination
of ore and Genprey parts. Has
been extremely finely crafted.

pieces.name: Genprey Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings made by combining
Genprey parts with fine ore.
Provides good feet protection.

pieces.name: Vespoid Helm
pieces.desc:
Made of Vespoid parts. Weak
against Fire, but its hard
shell offers solid defense.

pieces.name: Vespoid Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made of Vespoid
materials. Expertly crafted
to withstand physical attacks.

pieces.name: Vespoid Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of Vespoid
parts. Heavier than they appear,
with equally high Defense.

pieces.name: Vespoid Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made after an
intense study of Vespoid
lifestyle and its strong points.

pieces.name: Vespoid Greaves
pieces.desc:
Greaves crafted from Vespoid
parts to have high defensive
power. Harder than they look.

pieces.name: Vespoid Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of Vespoid
parts. It is hard to believe
this cap was once insect shell.

pieces.name: Vespoid Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor expertly
crafted to increase the
wearer's Dragon Resistance.

pieces.name: Vespoid Guards
pieces.desc:
Guards made of Vespoid
materials. Carries the
insect's distinctive shine.

pieces.name: Vespoid Coat
pieces.desc:
Armor made of Vespoid parts.
Expertly crafted for increased
Dragon Resistance.

pieces.name: Vespoid Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings covered in Vespoid
material. They protect against
strong physical attacks.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Helm
pieces.desc:
A helm made of Hornetaur
materials. The shiny materials
are often mistaken for metal.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Mail
pieces.desc:
Mail covered in strong Hornetaur
materials. Known for its shine
and shoulder spikes.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Braces
pieces.desc:
Armor covered in strong
Hornetaur materials. High
Defense and Dragon Resistance.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Tassets
pieces.desc:
Eye-catching tassets made of
Hornetaur material. Known for
strength and Dragon Resistance.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Greaves
pieces.desc:
Made of Hornetaur material.
High Defense, but can't
withstand elemental attacks.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Cap
pieces.desc:
A helm made of strong Hornetaur
materials. Heavy armor with
notable Dragon Resistance.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Vest
pieces.desc:
Armor covered in strong Hornetaur
materials. Its crafting takes more
than one hundred steps.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Guards
pieces.desc:
Armor made of Hornetaur material.
Even small parts are crafted
with attention to detail.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Coat
pieces.desc:
Armor made of Hornetaur
material. High Dragon Resistance
makes this a hunter essential.

pieces.name: Hornetaur Leggings
pieces.desc:
Covered in strong Hornetaur
materials. Crafted in a time-
consuming, detailed process.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Hat
pieces.desc:
Insect head armor made for
a certain aristocrat. Causes
quite a stir at parties.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Suit
pieces.desc:
Insect chest armor made for
an aristocrat with unusual
tastes. Close-fitting.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Gloves
pieces.desc:
Rare armguards made from insect
parts. Many collectors are
obsessed with finding a pair.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Coil
pieces.desc:
Waist armor created for a
fanciful aristocrat, who was
fond of collecting curiosities.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Boots
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made of insect
parts. A novelty, but
excellently designed.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Headpiece
pieces.desc:
Insect head armor made for an
aristocrat who loves to party.
It's both elegant and sturdy.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Vest
pieces.desc:
Insect chest armor of
bizarre design, commissioned
by an eccentric aristocrat.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Sleeves
pieces.desc:
Extremely rare armguards made
from insect parts. Sought after
by collectors everywhere.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made with insect
wings. Wear this, and you'll
be the life of the party.

pieces.name: Bnahabra Pants
pieces.desc:
Unusual leg armor made of
insect parts. Bizarre, but
popular for its elegance.

pieces.name: Konchu Helm
pieces.desc:
A helm made from Konchu
materials. Has a curvy, yet
insect-like design.

pieces.name: Konchu Braces
pieces.desc:
Putting your arms in these is
like going inside a Konchu.
Hunter tried and tested.

pieces.name: Konchu Cap
pieces.desc:
The iridescent green makes
it the perfect addition to
any Konchu fan's collection.

pieces.name: Konchu Guards
pieces.desc:
Putting your arms in these is
like going inside a Konchu --
and who wouldn't love that?

pieces.name: Mosswine Mask
pieces.desc:
Armor made to look like the
face of a Mosswine. You never
sausage a thing!

pieces.name: Mosswine Vest
pieces.desc:
Body armor designed to
resemble a Mosswine.
Even smells like one...

pieces.name: Mosswine Gloves
pieces.desc:
Vambraces made from a
Mosswine. Covered in moss
and awesome.

pieces.name: Mosswine Hip
pieces.desc:
Tassets made from Mosswine
parts. It'll save your bacon
while your hips are shakin'.

pieces.name: Mosswine Feet
pieces.desc:
Boots that imitate the hind
legs of a Mosswine. They'll
make you wanna dance a jig.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from
Rhenoplos parts. Used when
searching sand for ore and water.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from stout
materials. Airtight design
keeps water and sand out.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Armguards with only three
fingers, but still possessed
of a formidable grip.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Coil
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from
Rhenoplos parts. Ideal for desert
water and ore prospecting.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Greaves
pieces.desc:
Rhenoplos leg armor. Often
used when mining resources
for city development.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from
Rhenoplos parts. Strong enough
to burrow through bedrock.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor originally used
for mining. Used by countless
construction workers.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Guards
pieces.desc:
Surprisingly wieldy
armguards with a unique
three-finger design.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from
Rhenoplos parts, with wide
coverage for the legs.

pieces.name: Rhenoplos Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor originally used
for mining, but effective
enough for hunting.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Helm
pieces.desc:
Perfect for those who
like to head-butt first
and ask questions later.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor for those who
take pride in their reckless
nature.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Braces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces that're more
for bashin' than they are
for protectin'.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor aimed at
hunters that prefer to live
amidst nature and wildlife.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor for hunters that
want to awaken their savage
instincts from within.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Cap
pieces.desc:
Headgear that serves as
a symbol of the wearer's
wild nature and spirit.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor that serves as a
symbol of the wearer's sheer
physical size and bulk.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards that serve as a
symbol of the wearer's
sheer power and strength.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor that serves as a
symbol of the wearer's bulk
and superior muscular build.

pieces.name: Bulldrome Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor that serves as a
symbol of the wearer's kind
yet strong nature.

pieces.name: Bullfango Mask
pieces.desc:
Armor made to look like the
head of a Bullfango. Be as
bull-headed as you want!

pieces.name: Arzuros Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from Arzuros
parts. Widely used by hunters
who frequent Yukumo Village.

pieces.name: Arzuros Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from Arzuros
parts. Light and sturdy, with a
design that's pure Yukumo.

pieces.name: Arzuros Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Armguards crafted from Arzuros
parts. Made with a distinctive
Yukumo design.

pieces.name: Arzuros Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Arzuros
parts. Modest and functional, it
highlights its material's texture.

pieces.name: Arzuros Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Arzuros
parts. Designed for hunting in
wooded, mountainous terrain.

pieces.name: Arzuros Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from Arzuros
parts. Designed to value weight
and field of vision over Defense.

pieces.name: Arzuros Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from Arzuros
parts. Its design is a fusion of
Yukumo and Eastern styles.

pieces.name: Arzuros Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from Arzuros
parts. Finely tuned for use by
Gunners.

pieces.name: Arzuros Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Arzuros
parts. Its beautiful loincloth
is a famous traditional handicraft.

pieces.name: Arzuros Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Arzuros
parts. Its sharp design boldly
reproduces the beast's forelegs.

pieces.name: Cephalos Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from Cephalos
materials. The large decorative
fin shines proudly to all.

pieces.name: Cephalos Mail
pieces.desc:
Made from Cephalos parts.
Quite sturdy, though weak
against Ice attacks.

pieces.name: Cephalos Braces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces made of Cephalos
materials. Breathable for
use under the blazing sun.

pieces.name: Cephalos Tassets
pieces.desc:
Made from Cephalos parts.
Its scales are tough, but
it's weak against Ice.

pieces.name: Cephalos Greaves
pieces.desc:
Greaves made of seamless
Cephalos scales. Decorated
with beautiful ornaments.

pieces.name: Cephalos Cap
pieces.desc:
Headgear made from Cephalos
materials. The tiny scales it
uses improve Fire Resistance.

pieces.name: Cephalos Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from the finest
Cephalos materials. Its trademark
fin adorns the shoulder.

pieces.name: Cephalos Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from Cephalos
parts. A large, wide,
shield-like fin defends the arm.

pieces.name: Cephalos Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Cephalos
parts. The quality scales provide
superb Defense.

pieces.name: Cephalos Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings made from Cephalos
materials. The Cephalos
scales are linked tightly.

pieces.name: Derring Headgear
pieces.desc:
Head armor tailored for the
Caravan and engraved with
their unmistakable emblem.

pieces.name: Derring Jacket
pieces.desc:
Chest armor tailored for the
Caravan. Set forth into the
unknown with shoulders high.

pieces.name: Derring Gloves
pieces.desc:
Gloves tailored for the
Caravan. Their quality ensures
a firm and reliable grip.

pieces.name: Derring Belt
pieces.desc:
Waist armor tailored for the
Caravan. Sturdy and designed
to get the job done.

pieces.name: Derring Trousers
pieces.desc:
Leg armor tailored for the
Caravan. Holds up well
on long treks and climbs.

pieces.name: Alloy Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made with quality
Machalite Ore. Highly
functional defensive armor.

pieces.name: Alloy Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made with quality
Machalite Ore. Has a logical,
no-frills construction.

pieces.name: Alloy Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Armguards made with quality
Machalite Ore. Their precise
design is admirable.

pieces.name: Alloy Coil
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made with quality
Machalite Ore. Its sleek
design has real beauty.

pieces.name: Alloy Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made with quality
Machalite Ore. Its design
is extremely practical.

pieces.name: Alloy Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made with quality
Machalite Ore. Sturdy
equipment for Gunners.

pieces.name: Alloy Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made with quality
Machalite Ore. Smartly de-
signed for top performance.

pieces.name: Alloy Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made with quality
Machalite Ore. Admired for
their simple design.

pieces.name: Alloy Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made with quality
Machalite Ore. Its design
exudes fine craftsmanship.

pieces.name: Alloy Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made with quality
Machalite Ore. Especially
designed for Gunners.

pieces.name: Battle Helm
pieces.desc:
Helm made for hunters. A
special piece unattainable
by mere novices.

pieces.name: Battle Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made especially
for hunters. Many trust in its
protection and practicality.

pieces.name: Battle Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces made for hunters.
Ease of movement makes these
extremely practical.

pieces.name: Battle Tassets
Battle Greaves
pieces.desc:
Custom greaves designed for
hunters. Prized for their
high quality.

pieces.name: Battle Cap
pieces.desc:
Cap made for hunters. This
proves one's place among
hunting's upper echelon.

pieces.name: Battle Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made especially
for hunters. It has ammunition
pockets for extra convenience.

pieces.name: Battle Guards
pieces.desc:
Custom-made guards for
hunters. Allow easy movement
during firing.

pieces.name: Battle Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made especially
for hunters. Made with light
materials for functionality.

pieces.name: Battle Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings for hunters. A
crystallization of design
without compromise.

pieces.name: Ingot Helm
pieces.desc:
Gleaming head armor made of
Dragonite Ore. Makes the
most of its metallic alloy.

pieces.name: Ingot Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made of carefully-
chosen Dragonite Ore. Its soft,
golden glow is striking.

pieces.name: Ingot Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of quality
Dragonite Ore. Their layered
construction is very sturdy.

pieces.name: Ingot Coil
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made with ample
Dragonite Ore, following the
contours of the body.

pieces.name: Ingot Greaves
pieces.desc:
Golden leg armor that makes
lavish use of high quality
Dragonite Ore.

pieces.name: Ingot Cap
pieces.desc:
Gleaming head armor made of
Dragonite Ore, boasting the
heft of precious metal.

pieces.name: Ingot Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made of carefully-
chosen Dragonite Ore. Its thick
plates are highly reliable.

pieces.name: Ingot Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of quality
Dragonite Ore. Rather high
Defense for metallic guards.

pieces.name: Ingot Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made with ample
Dragonite Ore, using cutting-
edge forging techniques.

pieces.name: Ingot Leggings
pieces.desc:
Golden leg armor forged from
lots of Dragonite Ore. Worn
by many a mid-level hunter.

pieces.name: High Metal Helm
pieces.desc:
Headgear made from rare ore.
Loved by hunters for its
simplicity.

pieces.name: High Metal Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from
rare ore. Very difficult to
damage.

pieces.name: High Metal Braces
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from rare ore.
Even when trampled by a wyvern
they don't lose their shape.

pieces.name: High Metal Tassets
pieces.desc:
Primarily made of a rare
ore. Strength above that
of normal wyvern armor.

pieces.name: High Metal Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor primarily made of
rare ore. Quite strong against
physical attacks.

pieces.name: High Metal Cap
pieces.desc:
Headgear made from rare ore.
Many see it as the pinnacle
of beauty.

pieces.name: High Metal Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from
rare ore. Highly resistant
to Thunder.

pieces.name: High Metal Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards primarily made of
rare ore. Gunner's armor, but
still highly protective.

pieces.name: High Metal Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor primarily made of
heavy ore. Incredibly strong,
yet flexible.

pieces.name: High Metal Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor primarily made of
rare ore. Excellent armor
forged using careful crafting.

pieces.name: Metal Boots
pieces.desc:
Boots with an icy radiance,
like mountainside water. Has
an unimaginably hard surface.

pieces.name: Metal Feet
pieces.desc:
Boots with an icy radiance,
like mountainside water. Has
an unimaginably hard surface.

pieces.name: Melahoa Hat
pieces.desc:
A hat with a vaguely familiar
smell. Recalls memories of a
love from days gone by.

pieces.name: Melahoa Jacket
pieces.desc:
Armor with a fragrant aroma.
Those wrapped in its smell
float in nostalgia.

pieces.name: Melahoa Branch
pieces.desc:
This armor's faint color and
smell can bring tears to an
old hunter's eyes.

pieces.name: Melahoa Folia
pieces.desc:
Strange armor with a
fragrant aroma. Its hue is
thanks to special materials.

pieces.name: Melahoa Roots
pieces.desc:
Armor with a lovely aroma.
Its intoxicating fragrance
can make one impulsive.

pieces.name: Melahoa Bloom
pieces.desc:
Armor with a lovely aroma.
Its uniqueness and mystery
captures the hearts of many.

pieces.name: Melahoa Stalk
pieces.desc:
Armor with a faint sweet
odor. It has a charmingly
strange color and construction.

pieces.name: Melahoa Petal
pieces.desc:
Armor with a lovely aroma.
Many women see their own
fleeting love in its petals.

pieces.name: Melahoa Trunk
pieces.desc:
Armor with a lovely aroma.
Its soft touch and sweet smell
evoke a nostalgic feeling.

pieces.name: Melahoa Taproot
pieces.desc:
Armor with a lovely aroma.
Its sweet smell overwhelms
even a wyvern's senses.

pieces.name: Makluva Hood
pieces.desc:
A fish scale hood that covers
the head entirely. Firm, yet
soft; truly strange armor.

pieces.name: Makluva Cover
pieces.desc:
Armor made from fish scales.
The hard material is closely
knitted to prevent gaps.

pieces.name: Makluva Sleeves
pieces.desc:
Armor made from fish scales
that gently protects its wearer.
Its strange color is charming.

pieces.name: Makluva Coil
pieces.desc:
Popular due to its superb
color; impossible to extract
from wyvern material.

pieces.name: Makluva Pants
pieces.desc:
Armor made from fish scales.
Soft material allows you to
feel the earth underfoot.

pieces.name: Makluva Gills
pieces.desc:
A fish scale hood that covers
the head entirely. Intricate
webbing with a soft feel.

pieces.name: Makluva Scale
pieces.desc:
Armor made from fish scales.
Crafted with the goal of
warding off impacts.

pieces.name: Makluva Sucker
pieces.desc:
Armor made from fish scales.
Soft, yet still able to
effectively repel attacks.

pieces.name: Makluva Fin
pieces.desc:
Armor made from fish scales.
So soft that it makes its
scaly origin unfathomable.

pieces.name: Makluva Leggings
pieces.desc:
Armor made from fish scales.
Causes a strange sensation
as you traverse the earth.

pieces.name: Bistro Toque
pieces.desc:
Worn by those aiming to be
1st-class chefs. Embroidered
with "Devoted to Cooking."

pieces.name: Bistro Suit
pieces.desc:
Worn by those aiming to be
1st-class chefs. Embroidered
with "Cooking is Courage."

pieces.name: Bistro Sarong
pieces.desc:
Worn by those aiming to be
1st-class chefs. Embroidered
with "Cooking is Love."

pieces.name: Bistro Cap
pieces.desc:
Worn by those aiming to be
1st-class chefs. Embroidered
with "Devoted to Cooking."

pieces.name: Bistro Vest
pieces.desc:
Worn by those aiming to be
1st-class chefs. Embroidered
with "Cooking is Courage."

pieces.name: Bistro Apron
pieces.desc:
Worn by those aiming to be
1st-class chefs. Embroidered
with "Cooking is Love."

pieces.name: Obituary Vertex
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from bug
parts. This noble horn is proof
of mastery over insect kind.

pieces.name: Obituary Thorax
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from
insect parts. Quite tough
for armor made from insects.

pieces.name: Obituary Brachia
pieces.desc:
Armor to fulfill the ambitions
of men who dreamed of wielding
the power of the insect king.

pieces.name: Obituary Elytra
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from insect
materials. Wearers resemble a
black bullet when running.

pieces.name: Obituary Crura
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from insect
materials. Unyielding, even
if trampled by a wyvern.

pieces.name: Obituary Clypeus
pieces.desc:
Armor made of bug parts. Its
power allows the wearer to
rout even small bird wyverns.

pieces.name: Obituary Pleuron
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from
insect parts that is longed
for by many children.

pieces.name: Obituary Manus
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of bug parts.
Proof of a skillful hero who
protects insects as their king.

pieces.name: Obituary Alae
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from insect
parts. Its heavy appearance
hides its surprising mobility.

pieces.name: Obituary Tarsi
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from insect
materials. Its firm grip
makes it very popular.

pieces.name: Butterfly Vertex
pieces.desc:
Armor crafted from insect
material. Feels airy, but
excels at absorbing impacts.

pieces.name: Butterfly Thorax
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from
insect parts. It can make
any movement look graceful.

pieces.name: Butterfly Brachia
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of bug parts.
A gorgeous piece with the
feeling of fine silk.

pieces.name: Butterfly Elytra
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made of insect
materials. Dazzling equipment
with the class of a lady.

pieces.name: Butterfly Crura
pieces.desc:
Armor made of insect parts.
Its light weight and color are
proof of one's high class.

pieces.name: Butterfly Clypeus
pieces.desc:
Armor crafted from insect
material. When moving, it
glitters a beautiful white.

pieces.name: Butterfly Pleuron
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from
insect parts. Desired by
women for its brilliant color.

pieces.name: Butterfly Manus
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of bug parts.
A favorite with celebrities; make
the wearer look more elegant.

pieces.name: Butterfly Alae
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made of insect
materials. Brimming with the
grace of a celebrity hunter.

pieces.name: Butterfly Tarsi
pieces.desc:
Leg armor crafted from insect
material. A high class item
worn only by celebrities.

pieces.name: Death Stench Brain
pieces.desc:
Said to take one to the
netherworld. You can hear
the agony of the dead...

pieces.name: Death Stench Muscle
pieces.desc:
Armor that carries one to
death. Strangely light
and incredibly cold.

pieces.name: Death Stench Grip
pieces.desc:
Armor drenched in the stench
of decay. It feels as if the
god of death resides within.

pieces.name: Death Stench Bowels
pieces.desc:
Armor housing the stench of
decay. It feels like Death's
eyes are fixed upon you.

pieces.name: Death Stench Heel
pieces.desc:
Modeled on the god of death.
Hearing the black footsteps
means your time has come.

pieces.name: Death Stench Soul
pieces.desc:
Modeled on the god of death,
who reaps the souls of those
he lays his eyes upon.

pieces.name: Death Stench Heart
pieces.desc:
Cursed to bring about death.
The black god himself
appears before the dying...

pieces.name: Death Stench Grasp
pieces.desc:
Modeled on the god of death.
Powerful enough to suck the
life out of those nearby.

pieces.name: Death Stench Belly
pieces.desc:
Armor cursed to bring about
death. The smell of dried
blood never washes away.

pieces.name: Death Stench March
pieces.desc:
Said to take one to the
netherworld. The footsteps
in your head never cease...

pieces.name: Acorn Helm
pieces.desc:
Matching helms for you and
your Palico! Every Hunter's
dream come true!

pieces.name: Acorn Mail
pieces.desc:
Matching chest armor that
increases affinity between
Hunters and Palicoes.

pieces.name: Acorn Cap
pieces.desc:
Matching helms for you and
your Palico! Every Hunter's
dream come true!

pieces.name: Acorn Vest
pieces.desc:
Matching chest armor that
increases affinity between
Hunters and Palicoes.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Vizor
pieces.desc:
Headgear crafted from strange
pumpkins. The wearer can hear a
voice dispensing hunting advice.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Ribplate
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from strange
pumpkins. Its wearer need never
be afraid, come what may.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Creeper
pieces.desc:
Armguards crafted from strange
pumpkins. The material has been
toughened with a special chemical.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Folia
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted from strange
pumpkins. Apparently a smith
had some free time on his hands.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Roots
pieces.desc:
Leg armor crafted from strange
pumpkins. Be wary of bugs out to
nibble this armor for a snack!

pieces.name: Mosgharl Brim
pieces.desc:
Headgear crafted from strange
pumpkins. The carved face
resembles a jack-o'-lantern.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Ribguard
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from strange
pumpkins. Attune yourself to nature
to unlock its true power.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Tendril
pieces.desc:
Armguards crafted from strange
pumpkins. So artfully made, you'd
never guess they were pumpkins.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Fronds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted from strange
pumpkins. From behind, the wearer
looks like a wandering ghost.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Radicles
pieces.desc:
Leg armor crafted from strange
pumpkins. It's said they can sense
the footsteps of approaching foes.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Vizor
pieces.desc:
Headgear crafted from strange
pumpkins. They say those who
wear it can hear voices...

pieces.name: Mosgharl Ribplate
pieces.desc:
Crafted from strange
pumpkins. Surprisingly makes
for competent protection.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Creeper
pieces.desc:
Crafted from strange
pumpkins. Its power carries
an otherworldly aura.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Folia
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted from strange
pumpkins. Cute to look at,
but hard to really sit in.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Roots
pieces.desc:
Leg armor crafted from strange
pumpkins. Be wary of bugs out to
nibble this armor for a snack!

pieces.name: Mosgharl Brim
pieces.desc:
Headgear crafted from strange
pumpkins. Enhances senses in
exchange for mussed hair.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Ribguard
pieces.desc:
Chest armor crafted from
haunted pumpkins. Unknown
if carving does anything.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Tendril
pieces.desc:
Crafted from strange
pumpkins. Always dirty in
spite of housing a spirit.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Fronds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted from strange
pumpkins. Catching eyes with this
jack-o-lantern is way spooky.

pieces.name: Mosgharl Radicles
pieces.desc:
Crafted from strange
pumpkins. Comes bundled with
a pair of fetching boots.

pieces.name: Edel Vizor
pieces.desc:
Any situation will come up roses
while sporting this headgear.
Boasts great defense.

pieces.name: Edel Ribplate
pieces.desc:
You'll be no shrinking violet
on the battlefield wearing
this elegant chest armor.

pieces.name: Edel Creeper
pieces.desc:
Resembling a flower with
hanging petals -- not your
garden-variety armguards.

pieces.name: Edel Folia
pieces.desc:
They'll be no thorns in
your side when you don
this beautiful waist armor.

pieces.name: Edel Roots
pieces.desc:
Never let the grass grow
under your feet with this
exquisite leg armor.

pieces.name: Edel Bloom
pieces.desc:
Your hunting career will be
blossoming with this unique
and beautiful headgear.

pieces.name: Edel Ribguard
pieces.desc:
Enemies will be pushing up
daises while you stay safe
using this lovely chestpiece.

pieces.name: Edel Tendril
pieces.desc:
Even if you don't do so well
on a Quest, you'll come up
smelling of roses.

pieces.name: Edel Fronds
pieces.desc:
I won't give you any flowery
speech about how good this
armor is -- see for yourself!

pieces.name: Edel Radicles
pieces.desc:
Wearing this leg armor will
never lead you down the
primrose path.

pieces.name: Skalda Vertex
pieces.desc:
Head armor with a cruel
design. Resembles a scorpion
tail, ready to strike.

pieces.name: Skalda Thorax
pieces.desc:
Chest armor covered in
protective plating. Resembles
a scorpion's mesosoma.

pieces.name: Skalda Brachia
pieces.desc:
Segmented armguards that
feature curved stingers. As
creepy as they are effective.

pieces.name: Skalda Elytra
pieces.desc:
Waist armor accentuated
with a scorpion's tail. Sadly,
it's only for show.

pieces.name: Skalda Crura
pieces.desc:
Made to resemble the simple
and unadulterated killing
machine that is the scorpion.

pieces.name: Skalda Clypeus
pieces.desc:
Horrifying head armor.
Protects as much as it
instills fear.

pieces.name: Skalda Pleuron
pieces.desc:
Made from materials so
dangerous, they were
once banned from being used.

pieces.name: Skalda Manus
pieces.desc:
Guards with a deadly design.
Much too sharp and vicious
to be considered armor.

pieces.name: Skalda Alae
pieces.desc:
Waist armor with articulated
plating. Protects as much as it
"completes the look."

pieces.name: Skalda Tarsi
pieces.desc:
Made to resemble the deadly
scorpion, which many refer
to as the "crawling death."

pieces.name: Spio Vertex
pieces.desc:
Resembling the veil of a
noblewoman, it exudes beauty
as well as a sense of cruelty.

pieces.name: Spio Thorax
pieces.desc:
Featuring a spider-like
design, it hunts like a
predator in the darkness.

pieces.name: Spio Brachia
pieces.desc:
Featuring a spider-like
design, fear drips from the
fingers like blood.

pieces.name: Spio Elytra
pieces.desc:
Adorned with spider
decor, its blood red eyes
laugh coldly at its prey.

pieces.name: Spio Crura
pieces.desc:
Leg armor that enables an
elegant, yet coldhearted
gait.

pieces.name: Spio Clypeus
pieces.desc:
Resembles a maiden's veil.
Those who underestimate its
wearer meet a quick death.

pieces.name: Spio Pleuron
pieces.desc:
Perfect for concealing oneself
in the darkness. Feminine
lines help soften its brutal looks.

pieces.name: Spio Manus
pieces.desc:
Armguards made to resemble
a spider. The dark red eyes
peer into the souls of foes.

pieces.name: Spio Alae
pieces.desc:
Waist armor with decorations
that resemble insect wings,
designed to protect with fear.

pieces.name: Spio Tarsi
pieces.desc:
This terrifying leg armor
helps hunters stalk their
prey silently like a spider.

pieces.name: Droth Mail
pieces.desc:
Made from Ludroth parts --
known for its revealing
yet durable construction.

pieces.name: Droth Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from
Ludroth parts. Known for
the accentuating red ribbon.

pieces.name: Droth Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Ludroth
parts. Known for its simple
asymmetric design.

pieces.name: Droth Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from
Ludroth parts. Perfect for
wild and crazy Gunners.

pieces.name: Droth Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor that is perfect
for Gunners by the sea.
A lot softer than it looks.

pieces.name: Droth Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor that softly enwraps
a Gunner's feet. Perfect for
swift runs over sandy beaches.

pieces.name: Uroktor Torso
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from
Uroktor parts by a craftsman
hailing from a land of fire.

pieces.name: Uroktor Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Uroktor
parts that can withstand even
the heat of a raging volcano.

pieces.name: Uroktor Vest
pieces.desc:
Armor that protects the
vital areas. The favorite
of Fire Country Gunners.

pieces.name: Uroktor Coat
pieces.desc:
Made by a craftsman wishing
to offer superior protection
to the region's Gunners.

pieces.name: Larinoth Mask
pieces.desc:
Made from Larinoth parts for
the purpose of masquerades.
It smells "interesting..."

pieces.name: Gargwa Mask
pieces.desc:
Children flee in terror at the
sight of this unsettling mask
that resembles a Gargwa head.

pieces.name: Moofah Head
pieces.desc:
It is said that you'll dream
of Moofahs if you wear this
headgear to bed.

pieces.name: Moofah Suit
pieces.desc:
Popular with Hunters as
cold weather wear when
hunting in high altitudes.

pieces.name: Moofah Claws
pieces.desc:
Made from extremely warm
materials; popular with those
looking to beat the cold.

pieces.name: Moofah Coil
pieces.desc:
Made for Moofah lovers by
Moofah lovers with an acute
attention to detail.

pieces.name: Moofah Wig
pieces.desc:
Dress up as a Moofah with
this fluffy headgear. Did
we mention it's soft?

pieces.name: Moofah Jacket
pieces.desc:
Chest armor so soft you'll
think you're lying in a sea
of Moofahs.

pieces.name: Moofah Sleeves
pieces.desc:
Made of wool so comfy that
it has redefined the meaning
of softness and warmth.

pieces.name: Moofah Coat
pieces.desc:
Looking at this waist armor,
only one word comes to
mind -- fluffy.

pieces.name: False Felyne
pieces.desc:
Armor made to look like a
Felyne head. A famously
adorable item.

pieces.name: Velociprey Head
pieces.desc:
A mask made to resemble the
face of a Velociprey. Feels
as if it has a soul.

pieces.name: Velociprey Body
pieces.desc:
Armor that makes one feel
like a Velociprey. The blue
tint is very visible.

pieces.name: Velociprey Claws
pieces.desc:
Armor that makes one feel
like a Velociprey with its
hallmark giant claw.

pieces.name: Velociprey Feet
pieces.desc:
Makes one feel like a
Velociprey with an enormous
desire to hop around.

pieces.name: Velociprey Mask
pieces.desc:
A mask made to resemble the
face of a Velociprey. Feels
as if it has a soul.

pieces.name: Velociprey Suit
pieces.desc:
Armor that makes one feel
like a Velociprey. The blue
tint is very visible.

pieces.name: Velociprey Gloves
pieces.desc:
Armor that makes one feel
like a Velociprey with its
hallmark giant claw.

pieces.name: Velociprey Tights
pieces.desc:
Makes one feel like a
Velociprey with an enormous
desire to hop around.

pieces.name: Genprey Head
pieces.desc:
Armor made to look like
the head of a Genprey. Gives
a sense of Genprey cunning.

pieces.name: Genprey Body
pieces.desc:
Will make you as sly as a
Genprey when worn. The green
hue is quite pleasing.

pieces.name: Genprey Claws
pieces.desc:
Will make you as sly as a
Genprey when worn. It fits
perfectly on your hands.

pieces.name: Genprey Feet
pieces.desc:
Will make you as sly as a
Genprey when worn, pouncing
out from the darkness.

pieces.name: Genprey Mask
pieces.desc:
Armor made to look like
the head of a Genprey. Gives
a sense of Genprey cunning.

pieces.name: Genprey Suit
pieces.desc:
Will make you as sly as a
Genprey when worn. The green
hue is quite pleasing.

pieces.name: Genprey Gloves
pieces.desc:
Will make you as sly as a
Genprey when worn. It fits
perfectly on your hands.

pieces.name: Genprey Tights
pieces.desc:
Will make you as sly as a
Genprey when worn, pouncing
out from the darkness.

pieces.name: Ioprey Head
pieces.desc:
Head armor made to look like the
head of an Ioprey. Allows the
wearer to understand its rage.

pieces.name: Ioprey Body
pieces.desc:
Armor that makes the wearer
as angry as an Ioprey. Its
crimson hue fuels the spirit.

pieces.name: Ioprey Claws
pieces.desc:
Armor that makes the wearer
as angry as an Ioprey. Features
an expanded wrist cuff.

pieces.name: Ioprey Feet
pieces.desc:
Armor that makes the wearer as
angry as an Ioprey. Sharpen
those claws and let loose!

pieces.name: Ioprey Mask
pieces.desc:
Head armor that harnesses
the Ioprey's rage. So real,
other hunters might attack!

pieces.name: Ioprey Wear
pieces.desc:
Chest armor that speaks the
Ioprey's language: pure,
burning rage.

pieces.name: Ioprey Gloves
pieces.desc:
Armguards that speak the
Ioprey's language: anger.
The gloves steady shots.

pieces.name: Ioprey Tights
pieces.desc:
Leg armor that speaks the
Ioprey's language: anger.
Sure to improve footwork.

pieces.name: Remobra Headgear
pieces.desc:
Head armor that looks like
a Remobra head. Much softer
than the Velociprey model.

pieces.name: Remobra Suit
pieces.desc:
Chest armor fashioned from
Remobra spoils. Buyers love
the stunning jet black hue.

pieces.name: Remobra Gloves
pieces.desc:
Armguards fashioned from
Remobra spoils. Dark hues
give them a lawless look.

pieces.name: Remobra Belt
pieces.desc:
A belt fashioned from
Remobra spoils. Nothing says
"attitude" like a skull.

pieces.name: Remobra Feet
pieces.desc:
Leg armor fashioned from
Remobra spoils. Has a retro
look for "mature" hunters.

pieces.name: Remobra Mask
pieces.desc:
Head armor that looks like
a Remobra head. It hugs the
face and soothes the soul.

pieces.name: Remobra Wear
pieces.desc:
Chest armor fashioned from
Remobra spoils. Sturdy and
easy to move in.

pieces.name: Remobra Hands
pieces.desc:
Armguards fashioned from
Remobra spoils. Young folks
love the lustrous stripes.

pieces.name: Remobra Band
pieces.desc:
A unique belt fashioned from
Remobra spoils. The design
is in demand worldwide.

pieces.name: Remobra Tights
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Remobra
parts. A popular design that
doesn't restrict movement.

pieces.name: Ioprey Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of high-quality
Ioprey parts. A top-class item
from the 'Prey family.

pieces.name: Ioprey Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from
high-quality Ioprey parts.
Top class 'Prey armor.

pieces.name: Ioprey Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of high quality
Ioprey materials. A top-class
item from the 'Prey family.

pieces.name: Ioprey Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Ioprey
parts. Top of the line 'Prey
armor for ultimate protection.

pieces.name: Ioprey Greaves
pieces.desc:
Beautiful armor made from
red scales. Firmly plants
the feet in quality Ioprey.

pieces.name: Ioprey Cap
pieces.desc:
Beautiful cap made of red
scales. Crafted by weaving
select Ioprey material.

pieces.name: Ioprey Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor fastened with
beautiful red Ioprey scales.
Carefully handcrafted.

pieces.name: Ioprey Guards
pieces.desc:
Armor made of red scales.
A specially crafted combo of
quality Ioprey parts and ore.

pieces.name: Ioprey Coat
pieces.desc:
Beautiful armor made from
red scales. Expertly crafted
from Ioprey parts and ore.

pieces.name: Ioprey Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings crafted from fine
Ioprey parts. It is a superior
piece of 'Prey class armor.

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from superior
Kut-Ku parts. It brings to
mind the bird-like beast.

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from quality
Kut-Ku parts. Its unique color
evokes thoughts of a foreign land.

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Armguards clad in the pink of
another world. The thick shell
can repel even wyvern fangs.

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted from
Kut-Ku parts. Beware of its
sharp, spine-covered exterior!

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Kut-Ku
materials. Its design
stresses ease of movement.

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of strong Kut-Ku
shell. The wings are a testament
to its expert crafting.

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from quality
Kut-Ku parts. It is quite strong and
light, despite its thickness.

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Guards
pieces.desc:
These Kut-Ku armguards are
lighter than they look
and highly durable.

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Kut-Ku
parts. It boasts a firm design
that is covered in spines.

pieces.name: Kut-Ku Leggings
pieces.desc:
Made from Kut-Ku material.
Highly mobile armor with a
foreign-looking design.

pieces.name: Lagombi Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor with an exotic design
that contrasts nicely with its
icy, pure-white surface.

pieces.name: Lagombi Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor that uses soft,
voluminous Lagombi fur.
Feels wonderful to touch.

pieces.name: Lagombi Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Armguards coated with a gripping
abrasive. Their warm fur helps
protect hands from extreme cold.

pieces.name: Lagombi Faulds
pieces.desc:
Unique waist armor designed for
everyday use for those who live
in freezing climes.

pieces.name: Lagombi Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor covered in a Lagombi's
soft pelt. The abrasive texture
is helpful when hunting on ice.

pieces.name: Lagombi Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of Lagombi
parts. The forehead part can be
pulled down to protect the eyes.

pieces.name: Lagombi Vest
pieces.desc:
Exotic chest armor designed with
fur from Lagombi that have become
acclimated to life on the Tundra.

pieces.name: Lagombi Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards coated with a gripping
abrasive. Their thick fur helps
keep hands warm and mobile.

pieces.name: Lagombi Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor used in frigid
regions. Known and trusted for
its use as hunting equipment.

pieces.name: Lagombi Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor coated with a strong
gripping abrasive. The exotic
design makes it a work of art.

pieces.name: Gypceros Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor wrapped in rubbery
Gypceros hide, making it strong
against physical attacks.

pieces.name: Gypceros Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor wrapped in rubbery
Gypceros hide, making it
resistant to physical damage.

pieces.name: Gypceros Braces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces covered in
Gypceros hide, making them
resistant to weak attacks.

pieces.name: Gypceros Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor wrapped in Gypceros
hide. The thick, meaty skin
provides ample protection.

pieces.name: Gypceros Greaves
pieces.desc:
Greaves made by combining
Gypceros hide and special
ore. A special metal armor.

pieces.name: Gypceros Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of Gypceros
hide. Its peculiar appearance
causes indescribable terror.

pieces.name: Gypceros Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor wrapped in rubbery
Gypceros hide. It is highly
resistant to Thunder.

pieces.name: Gypceros Guards
pieces.desc:
Guards wrapped in Gypceros
hide. Highly durable, they
also offer high protection.

pieces.name: Gypceros Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor covered with
Gypceros hide. Resistant to
Thunder & Water.

pieces.name: Gypceros Leggings
pieces.desc:
Gypceros hide and special
ore make these leggings
resistant to Thunder.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Helm
pieces.desc:
Devilish head armor made of
durable Tetsucabra spoils.
Harbors the soul of a fierce hunter.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Mail
pieces.desc:
Rigid chest armor made from
Tetsucabra parts. Traditional
wear for Eastern heroes.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Braces
pieces.desc:
Rigid armguards made from
Tetsucabra parts. Designed
to protect the hands.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Faulds
pieces.desc:
Dashing waist armor with an
Eastern-dyed loincloth and
handcrafted fastener.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Greaves
pieces.desc:
Traditional Eastern armor
that fits snugly over the
legs for maximum protection.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Cap
pieces.desc:
Devilish head armor made of
durable Tetsucabra spoils.
Harbors the soul of a fierce hunter.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Vest
pieces.desc:
Rigid chest armor made from
Tetsucabra parts. A shining
example of Eastern artistry.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Guards
pieces.desc:
Rigid armguards made from
Tetsucabra parts. High Defense
without hampering the wearer.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Coat
pieces.desc:
Dashing waist armor with a
stirring loincloth that
leads hunters to victory.

pieces.name: Tetsucabra Leggings
pieces.desc:
Traditional Eastern leg
armor. Withstands even the
most vicious monster attack.

pieces.name: Hermitaur Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from strong
Daimyo Hermitaur parts. Its
curved surface deflects attacks.

pieces.name: Hermitaur Mail
pieces.desc:
Armor made of Daimyo
Hermitaur parts. Able to
withstand almost any impact.

pieces.name: Hermitaur Braces
pieces.desc:
These armguards made of
Daimyo Hermitaur are crafted
to be completely gap-free.

pieces.name: Hermitaur Tassets
pieces.desc:
Tassets made of Daimyo
Hermitaur. Protects vital points
without sacrificing mobility.

pieces.name: Hermitaur Greaves
pieces.desc:
Greaves made of Daimyo
Hermitaur materials. A light
step is the key to victory!

pieces.name: Hermitaur Cap
pieces.desc:
Armor made of Daimyo Hermitaur
parts. The stern mask restricts
vision but raises concentration.

pieces.name: Hermitaur Vest
pieces.desc:
Armor made of Daimyo Hermitaur
parts. The shell has been finely
crafted so there are no chinks.

pieces.name: Hermitaur Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made using Daimyo
Hermitaur parts and ore.
Superbly detailed crafting.

pieces.name: Hermitaur Coat
pieces.desc:
Armor made of Daimyo
Hermitaur. Strong, but still
allows full range of motion.

pieces.name: Hermitaur Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings made from Daimyo
materials. Covered in shell
but still easy to move in.

pieces.name: Volvidon Helm
pieces.desc:
Headgear worn by Fire Country
hunters. It symbolizes the fire
spirit they hold sacred.

pieces.name: Volvidon Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor covered in
Volvidon shell. The fleshy
surface absorbs blows nicely.

pieces.name: Volvidon Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Fire Country hunters have long
passed these armguards down to
their children as they come of age.

pieces.name: Volvidon Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made in reverence of
the fire spirit. Such refinement
is rare in hunting history.

pieces.name: Volvidon Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Volvidon
shell. The fire spirit is
embodied in its crimson form.

pieces.name: Volvidon Cap
pieces.desc:
Headgear passed down by hunters
from a harsh land of volcanoes
and fire.

pieces.name: Volvidon Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor worn by Fire Country
hunters. It symbolizes the fire
spirit they hold sacred.

pieces.name: Volvidon Guards
pieces.desc:
Fire Country armguards
customized for Gunner use. Note
the keen attention to detail.

pieces.name: Volvidon Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made of elastic
Volvidon shells, painstakingly
customized for Gunner use.

pieces.name: Volvidon Leggings
pieces.desc:
Shining crimson leg armor made
for the hunters of a harsh land
of smoke and flame.

pieces.name: Ludroth Helm
pieces.desc:
The spongy scales used in
this head armor are more
protective than most metals.

pieces.name: Ludroth Mail
pieces.desc:
Remarkably flexible chest armor.
The thick material has pockets
of air to keep it lightweight.

pieces.name: Ludroth Braces
pieces.desc:
Armguards covered in thick,
spongy scales. Fleshy, but
not a hindrance to movement.

pieces.name: Ludroth Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Ludroth
parts. The flared skirt provides
good leg coverage.

pieces.name: Ludroth Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor with an attractive
pattern. The flexible material
provides a snug fit.

pieces.name: Ludroth Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor with a peculiar,
wig-like appearance. Often
shocks craftsmen who see it.

pieces.name: Ludroth Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor with a moist
feel. Its unique design is
popular with youngsters.

pieces.name: Ludroth Guards
pieces.desc:
Water-resistant armguards.
Their spongy material has
remarkable water absorption.

pieces.name: Ludroth Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Ludroth
parts. Produced by a popular
fashion designer.

pieces.name: Ludroth Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from a spongy
material. Excellent style and
performance both.

pieces.name: Malfestio Helm
pieces.desc:
Made from beautiful Malfestio
parts. It can also be worn
to royal masquerade balls.

pieces.name: Malfestio Mail
pieces.desc:
Made from Malfestio parts.
Looks beautiful and also
offers high Defense.

pieces.name: Malfestio Braces
pieces.desc:
Made of Malfestio parts.
Suitable for formal parties
as well as deadly hunts.

pieces.name: Malfestio Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor famous for its
deep blue color, known to
locals as "Malfestio Indigo."

pieces.name: Malfestio Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor that can double
as formalwear to royal
masquerades.

pieces.name: Malfestio Cap
pieces.desc:
Elegant Malfestio headgear
worn by court jesters on the
night of a famous festival.

pieces.name: Malfestio Vest
pieces.desc:
Made to resemble the clothing
of a famous jester known
as the "Wisest of Fools."

pieces.name: Malfestio Guards
pieces.desc:
Armor made to look like the
gloves of a famous trickster
popular with the people.

pieces.name: Malfestio Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor fashioned in the
image of a famous magician's
customized attire.

pieces.name: Malfestio Leggings
pieces.desc:
Based on the designs of an
acrobat's clothing, enabling
a free range of motion.

pieces.name: Khezu Helm
pieces.desc:
Helm covered in Khezu hide.
It is dark...

pieces.name: Khezu Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor wrapped in Khezu
hide. It fits any wearer like a
glove.

pieces.name: Khezu Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces covered in Khezu
hide. The cool material feels
surprisingly good...

pieces.name: Khezu Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor covered in Khezu
hide. It fits any wearer like a
glove.

pieces.name: Khezu Greaves
pieces.desc:
Guards covered in Khezu hide.
The cool material feels
surprisingly pleasant...

pieces.name: Khezu Cap
pieces.desc:
Cap covered in Khezu hide.
It is suspicious...

pieces.name: Khezu Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor wrapped in Khezu
hide. Its supple texture is
extremely comfortable...

pieces.name: Khezu Guards
pieces.desc:
Guards covered in Khezu hide.
The strange texture of the
material is captivating...

pieces.name: Khezu Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made of Khezu hide.
Surprisingly comfortable once
you get used to it.

pieces.name: Khezu Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings covered in Khezu
hide. The strange feel of
the material is captivating...

pieces.name: Rathian Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor with a frightening
visage. It's imbued with the
Queen wyvern's grace and power.

pieces.name: Rathian Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor that lives up to
the name of the Queen, with
scales harder than metal.

pieces.name: Rathian Braces
pieces.desc:
Made from splendid green
scales. The beauty stands out
even among the flames.

pieces.name: Rathian Faulds
pieces.desc:
Regal viridian waist armor.
Will intimidate even the
most vicious monster.

pieces.name: Rathian Greaves
pieces.desc:
Greaves imbued with queenly
might. Wear them to make the
earth itself your ally.

pieces.name: Rathian Cap
pieces.desc:
Headgear worthy of the
Queen. A blazing inferno
wouldn't even blemish it.

pieces.name: Rathian Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor worthy of the
Queen of the Land. Virtually
impervious to flame.

pieces.name: Rathian Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards covered in elegant
green scales. One swipe with
these can douse an inferno.

pieces.name: Rathian Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor known by some
as an embodiment of the
majestic Queen of the Land.

pieces.name: Rathian Leggings
pieces.desc:
Regally beautiful leg armor,
sure to retain its elegance
even in the flames of hell.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Helm
pieces.desc:
Enhanced exoskeleton headgear
designed on ergonomic principles.
Light as silk but hard as steel.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Mail
pieces.desc:
Enhanced exoskeleton chest armor
prototype. Good defensively, but
otherwise an unknown quantity.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Braces
pieces.desc:
Enhanced exoskeleton armguards.
Still just prototypes, but they
already grant ample protection.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Faulds
pieces.desc:
The Guild used all its resources
to develop this shock-absorbent,
anti-flying-wyvern waist armor.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Greaves
pieces.desc:
Enhanced exoskeleton leg armor
that can awaken latent battle
ability in combat situations.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Cap
pieces.desc:
Enhanced exoskeleton headgear
developed using the Guild's
latest research and technology.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Vest
pieces.desc:
Enhanced exoskeleton chest armor.
Quite effective, though there's
always room for improvement.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards designed on ergonomic
principles. Crafted using the
latest Guild technology.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Coat
pieces.desc:
Enhanced exoskeleton waist
armor. Still a prototype, but
already first-class armor.

pieces.name: Nibelsnarf Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor designed from research
into the human body. It lets one
fight wyverns as an equal.

pieces.name: Blango Helm
pieces.desc:
Headgear made from Blangonga
materials. Overflowing with
the honor of a foreign god.

pieces.name: Blango Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made of Blangonga
parts. It has a distinct,
oriental feel to it.

pieces.name: Blango Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces made from Blangonga
parts. The carefully woven
fur is surprisingly strong.

pieces.name: Blango Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made of Blango
parts with technology from the
land of the Eastern gods.

pieces.name: Blango Greaves
pieces.desc:
Armor made of Blangonga parts.
The woven hide and fur
make this as tough as scale.

pieces.name: Blango Cap
pieces.desc:
A cap crafted from Blangonga
materials. Wearing it will
sharpen a sniper's mind.

pieces.name: Blango Vest
pieces.desc:
A fur-covered vest made of
Blangonga parts. Thin, yet
resistant to cold temperatures.

pieces.name: Blango Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of Blangonga
materials. The simple design
protects wearers from the cold.

pieces.name: Blango Coat
pieces.desc:
A coat crafted from Blango
materials. It has a distinct,
oriental style.

pieces.name: Blango Leggings
pieces.desc:
Armor made of Blangonga
parts. The design is modeled
after Eastern religious costumes.

pieces.name: Ceanataur Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of Shogun
Ceanataur parts. The ridge is
sturdy enough to rip steel.

pieces.name: Ceanataur Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from the blade
of a Shogun Ceanataur. Can be
harmful if handled carelessly.

pieces.name: Ceanataur Braces
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of Shogun
Ceanataur parts. The sharp blade
provides extra damage.

pieces.name: Ceanataur Tassets
pieces.desc:
The hard shell of a Shogun
Ceanataur. Its blades are
still intact, so beware!

pieces.name: Ceanataur Greaves
pieces.desc:
Greaves made of Shogun
Ceanataur parts. They represent
the latest in technology.

pieces.name: Ceanataur Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of Shogun
Ceanataur parts. Crafted to
exploit the shell's sturdiness.

pieces.name: Ceanataur Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor expertly crafted
from Shogun Ceanataur parts.
Near-flawless design.

pieces.name: Ceanataur Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of Shogun
Ceanataur parts. The huge blade
makes the wearer intimidating.

pieces.name: Ceanataur Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted from
Shogun Ceanataur. Metal
covers gaps in the shell.

pieces.name: Ceanataur Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings made of Shogun
Ceanataur parts. The sharp
blades assure solid footing.

pieces.name: Najarala Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made by a people
who wear the fearsome
Najarala to drive evil away.

pieces.name: Najarala Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor with historic
value. Passed down through
a clan of fine warriors.

pieces.name: Najarala Braces
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from Najarala
parts. Valued for their
defensive capabilities.

pieces.name: Najarala Faulds
pieces.desc:
Vivid waist armor made from
tough Najarala carapace and
adorned with rousing ornamentation.

pieces.name: Najarala Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor that one region's
intrepid trekkers have used
for ages to walk the world.

pieces.name: Najarala Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor worn by leaders
in one part of the world.
Some call it a work of art.

pieces.name: Najarala Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor with a long
tradition. The red eyes on
the shoulders inspire fear.

pieces.name: Najarala Guards
pieces.desc:
Tough armguards with a
spiral design. Traditionally
worn by upstanding warriors.

pieces.name: Najarala Coat
pieces.desc:
Vibrant, ornamented Najarala
waist armor. A prize for
seekers of high Defense.

pieces.name: Najarala Leggings
pieces.desc:
Divine leg armor that
whispers tales of the proud
warriors who have worn it.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Helm
pieces.desc:
A helm that recalls a Nargacuga's
haunting eyes, tracking their
prey from the darkness.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor reminiscent of a
Nargacuga's body. Its glossy
scales possess a fragile beauty.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Braces
pieces.desc:
Black braces that resemble a
Nargacuga's claws. They clasp
weapons like a vice.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Faulds
pieces.desc:
A black belt reminiscent of
Nargacuga wings. The shiny fur
has a supernatural aura.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Greaves
pieces.desc:
Black greaves that resemble a
Nargacuga's legs. Many are drawn
to the dark power they radiate.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Cap
pieces.desc:
Headgear dark as midnight.
Whoever wears it can become
as one with the shadows.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor dark as midnight.
Light looks like a shooting
star reflecting off its surface.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards dark as midnight.
Any weapon they hold stands out
like a full moon against a dark sky.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor dark as midnight.
Even the shadow of the one who
wears it seems somehow sinister.

pieces.name: Nargacuga Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor dark as midnight.
Seeing its wearer dart through
the shadows is unsettling.

pieces.name: Scholarly Hood
pieces.desc:
Based on the cap worn at the
Wycademy. Just wearing it
makes one look smarter.

pieces.name: Scholarly Suit
pieces.desc:
Based on the clothing worn by
Wycademy researchers. The
kerchief signifies prestige.

pieces.name: Scholarly Grips
pieces.desc:
Developed under the watchful
eye of the Wycademy by
some of its keenest minds.

pieces.name: Scholarly Sash
pieces.desc:
Wycademy waist armor proving
the old adage "the pen is
mightier than the monster."

pieces.name: Scholarly Boots
pieces.desc:
Leg armor that has been
developed by some of the
finest minds at the Wycademy.

pieces.name: Scholarly Cap
pieces.desc:
Based on the cap worn by the
Wycademy. Just wearing it
makes you (look) smarter.

pieces.name: Scholarly Vest
pieces.desc:
Based on the clothing worn by
Wycademy researchers. The
badge shows their dedication.

pieces.name: Scholarly Cuffs
pieces.desc:
Developed by the Wycademy,
this armor reeks of quality
...and monster innards.

pieces.name: Scholarly Coat
pieces.desc:
Wycademy waist armor proving
the axiom that wisdom is a
hunter's greatest strength.

pieces.name: Scholarly Tights
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made for students
who constantly devote
themselves to their studies.

pieces.name: Vaik Helm
pieces.desc:
Beloved by hunters from the
sea. This helm gives them the
courage to face the waters.

pieces.name: Vaik Mail
pieces.desc:
Beloved by hunters from the
sea. Multiple refinements
prepare it for rough seas.

pieces.name: Vaik Braces
pieces.desc:
Beloved by hunters from the
sea. The sharp fins protect
the wearer in battle.

pieces.name: Vaik Faulds
pieces.desc:
Beloved by hunters from the
sea. A symbol of their
passion for sailing.

pieces.name: Vaik Greaves
pieces.desc:
Beloved by hunters from the
sea. It has many traits
designed for sea hunting.

pieces.name: Vaik Cap
pieces.desc:
Beloved by hunters from the
sea. It features a pair of
fins and a unique visor.

pieces.name: Vaik Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor that is trusted
by hunters that have come
across the mighty Leviathan.

pieces.name: Vaik Guards
pieces.desc:
Beloved by hunters from
the sea. Highly practical in
battle.

pieces.name: Vaik Coat
pieces.desc:
Beloved by hunters from the
sea. Only those who've proven
their mettle may wear it.

pieces.name: Vaik Leggings
pieces.desc:
Beloved by hunters from the
sea. Keeps your stance steady
even on rough waters.

pieces.name: Skull Visage
pieces.desc:
A mask for impersonating
the dead. They say its owner can
hear the cries of lost souls.

pieces.name: Skull Mask
pieces.desc:
A mask for impersonating
the dead. Wear it too long,
and your soul could be lost.

pieces.name: Aelucanth Vertex
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from bug parts.
It attests to one's power
in the insect kingdom.

pieces.name: Aelucanth Thorax
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from bug parts.
Stand in the sun wearing this
and you will feel invincible!

pieces.name: Aelucanth Brachia
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from bug parts.
They can withstand even
a brute wyvern's charge.

pieces.name: Aelucanth Elytra
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from bug
parts. Meant to be worn by a
champion of the insect tribes.

pieces.name: Aelucanth Crura
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from bug parts.
All insects bow before the
sight of nature's champion!

pieces.name: Aelucanth Clypeus
pieces.desc:
Headgear made from bug parts.
Don it and lead the insect
tribes onward to conquest!

pieces.name: Aelucanth Pleuron
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from bug parts.
The antennae on it are meant to
evoke a cape for the insect hero.

pieces.name: Aelucanth Manus
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from bug parts.
Worn by a hero of the insects
in their epic quest for glory.

pieces.name: Aelucanth Alae
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from bug parts.
Even flying-wyvern fangs can't
pierce this well-honed armor.

pieces.name: Aelucanth Tarsi
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from bug parts.
Every move is another step to a
brave new world for all insects.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Vertex
pieces.desc:
Headgear made from insect parts.
Man and beast alike are
transfixed by its giant ribbon.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Thorax
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from insects.
The elegant outstretched wings
are guaranteed to turn heads.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Brachia
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from insect
parts. Their flared curves are
favored by more stylish hunters.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Elytra
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from insect
parts. Of such quality that even
rolling in mud can't stain it.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Crura
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from insects.
Their wearer floats like a
butterfly, stings like a bee.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Clypeus
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from insect
parts. Designed to shield even
the nape of the wearer's neck.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Pleuron
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from insect
parts. As fair as any flower
found on the hunting grounds.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Manus
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from insects.
They add a bit of class to any
activity, even monster hunting.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Alae
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from insect
parts. This elegant piece is the
pride of a true armor artisan.

pieces.name: Rhopessa Tarsi
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from insect
parts. Revered by even the
wealthiest, most elite hunters.

pieces.name: Artian Mail
pieces.desc:
Rigid chest armor made from an
unknown metal that astounded
artisans when it was excavated.

pieces.name: Artian Braces
pieces.desc:
Armor made from the remains
of an excavated artifact. Its
origins are a mystery lost to time.

pieces.name: Artian Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from the remains
of an excavated artifact. May
have once contained moving parts.

pieces.name: Artian Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from the remains
of an excavated artifact. Alas,
some parts were beyond repair.

pieces.name: Artian Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from the remains
of an excavated artifact. Its gear
portions were used to craft these.

pieces.name: Artian Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from the remains
of an excavated artifact. Were
these mechanical puppet legs?

pieces.name: Garuga Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor that resembles the
sinister head of a Yian Garuga.
Gives off an eerie aura.

pieces.name: Garuga Mail
pieces.desc:
Deep purple armor made from
Yian Garuga parts. It is said the
beast's rage dwells within it.

pieces.name: Garuga Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces made from Yian
Garuga parts. The anger inside
deflects attacks.

pieces.name: Garuga Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Yian
Garuga parts. The ferocity of
the beast is trapped within.

pieces.name: Garuga Greaves
pieces.desc:
Contains the compressed shell
of the furious Yian Garuga, a
part that provides high Defense.

pieces.name: Garuga Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made of Yian Garuga
parts. The power within gives
the wearer sharp reflexes.

pieces.name: Garuga Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from Yian
Garuga shell, which grows
stronger whenever damaged.

pieces.name: Garuga Guards
pieces.desc:
Guards that are said to hold
the soul of a marksman. This
armor protects that soul.

pieces.name: Garuga Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor imbued with the
wrath of Yian Garuga. Wearing it
instills both respect and fear.

pieces.name: Garuga Leggings
pieces.desc:
Replica of Eastern fashion.
The power of the parts gives
extra strength to the legs.

pieces.name: Garuga Mask
pieces.desc:
Armor made to look like a Garuga
head. Its jutting chin and
wide ears are terrifying.

pieces.name: Uragaan Helm
pieces.desc:
Heavy head armor made up of
Uragaan parts. Its defensive
ability matches its weight.

pieces.name: Uragaan Mail
pieces.desc:
Heavy chest armor made up of
Uragaan parts. Excellent
Defense, but tough to handle.

pieces.name: Uragaan Vambraces
pieces.desc:
Heavy arm armor made of
Uragaan parts. Hard enough
to shatter rock.

pieces.name: Uragaan Faulds
pieces.desc:
Heavy Uragaan waist armor.
Its plates protect the
wearer from waist to knee.

pieces.name: Uragaan Greaves
pieces.desc:
Heavy leg armor made up of
Uragaan parts. Don them to
become a walking fortress.

pieces.name: Uragaan Cap
pieces.desc:
Heavy Uragaan head armor.
Protects the head like an
exoskeleton skull.

pieces.name: Uragaan Vest
pieces.desc:
Heavy chest armor made up of
Uragaan parts. Quite tough
for Gunner equipment.

pieces.name: Uragaan Guards
pieces.desc:
Heavy Uragaan armguards.
Despite their weight, they
offer excellent mobility.

pieces.name: Uragaan Coat
pieces.desc:
Heavy waist armor made up of
Uragaan parts. Tremendously
reliable protection.

pieces.name: Uragaan Leggings
pieces.desc:
Heavy leg armor made up of
Uragaan parts. Muscular legs
are a must to wear it.

pieces.name: Rathalos Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor equivalent to a
king's crown. Unparalleled
Defense for its class.

pieces.name: Rathalos Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor that carries on
the King of the Skies' legacy.
Essentially flawless.

pieces.name: Rathalos Braces
pieces.desc:
Imbued with the power of
the King of the Skies. Their
strikes can cleave air.

pieces.name: Rathalos Faulds
pieces.desc:
Crimson waist armor steeped
in victory. Don it to gain
wyvern-like appeal.

pieces.name: Rathalos Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made with powerful
Rathalos parts. Reminiscent
of a sky-dancing wyvern.

pieces.name: Rathalos Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor all hunters wish
for. Its wearers take on the
appearance of the King.

pieces.name: Rathalos Vest
pieces.desc:
Armor of the King, wreathed
in flame. Not even hell's
inferno could tarnish it.

pieces.name: Rathalos Guards
pieces.desc:
Guards endowed with enough
kingly power to disperse
thunderclouds with a wave.

pieces.name: Rathalos Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor crafted from
Rathalos parts. Almost
looks like flickering flame.

pieces.name: Rathalos Leggings
pieces.desc:
