Leg armor of the King of the
Skies. All the world's flame
couldn't hope to burn it.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Helm
pieces.desc:
Mighty azure head armor that
reflects the glory of besting
the Lord of the Seas.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor reinforced with
azure plate. Has the power
to fend off any impact.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Braces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces made with all the
force of Lagiacrus, eclipsing
standard equipment.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor that proves
the heroism of defeating a
Lagiacrus. Resists any impact.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor crafted from the
hard scales of a Lagiacrus.
Draws out latent abilities.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor and proof of
slaying a Lagiacrus. Provides
amazing Thunder Resistance.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Vest
pieces.desc:
Azure chest armor that is
said to grant courage.
Resists even Thunder.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from Lagiacrus
parts. Brings the force of
nature to aiming fingers.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor granted to those
who slay a Lagiacrus. A true
emblem of honor.

pieces.name: Lagiacrus Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor crafted from the
hard scales of a Lagiacrus.
Sharpens one's senses.

pieces.name: Zinogre Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor worthy of one
powerful enough to have defeated
even the mighty Zinogre.

pieces.name: Zinogre Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor like air-rending
lightning given form. Its owner
fights as if possessed by a demon.

pieces.name: Zinogre Braces
pieces.desc:
Armguards imbued with the power
of a Zinogre. They are the maxim
"might makes right" given form.

pieces.name: Zinogre Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor produced by pairing
master craftsmanship with parts
from the mighty Zinogre.

pieces.name: Zinogre Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor like soul-shattering
lightning given form. Its
allure is without equal.

pieces.name: Zinogre Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor fit for a conqueror.
The fierce flames about the eyes
prove its owner has no equal.

pieces.name: Zinogre Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor like Zinogre's
lightning given form. Its
capabilities are without equal.

pieces.name: Zinogre Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards said to be powerful
enough to lift the heavens
themselves.

pieces.name: Zinogre Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor that harnesses the
overwhelming power of Zinogre,
the ultimate hunter.

pieces.name: Zinogre Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Zinogre
shell. Whoever wears it fights
without fear, come what may.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Helm
pieces.desc:
A wedding headdress worn only
in the most elegant and
refined wedding ceremonies.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Mail
pieces.desc:
A piece of wedding attire
that took a holy maiden 100
nights to sew.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Braces
pieces.desc:
Wedding attire so lavish
and beautiful that it brings
kings to their knees.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Faulds
pieces.desc:
Captivating wedding attire so
alluring, people don't even
care about the wearer's tail.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Greaves
pieces.desc:
Beautiful wedding footwear
that features an enchanting
split-toe design.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Mask
pieces.desc:
Worn by those that watch over
wedding ceremonies. Kind of
smells like fried tofu.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Vest
pieces.desc:
Formalwear for ministers that
assist the bride and groom
during the wedding ceremony.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Guards
pieces.desc:
Worn by revelers during
weddings. It has a spot to
hide snacks in the sleeves.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Coat
pieces.desc:
A costume so captivating that
those who see it can overlook
the wearer's imperfections.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leggings worn by the wedding
procession. Look closely and
you can even see their paws.

pieces.name: Astalos Helm
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos on their head
trade honesty for cunning.

pieces.name: Astalos Mail
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos on their body
trade nobleness for guile.

pieces.name: Astalos Braces
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos on their arms
trade innocence for craft.

pieces.name: Astalos Faulds
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos round their waist
trade justice for deceit.

pieces.name: Astalos Greaves
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos on their legs
choose fear over truth.

pieces.name: Astalos Cap
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos on their head
trade purity for slyness.

pieces.name: Astalos Vest
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos on their body
trade integrity for logic.

pieces.name: Astalos Guards
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos on their arms
trade virtue for sagacity.

pieces.name: Astalos Coat
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos round their waist
trade innocence for acumen.

pieces.name: Astalos Leggings
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the
Astalos on their legs
choose fear over emotion.

pieces.name: Gammoth Helm
pieces.desc:
An ornamental helmet thought
to have been worn by warriors
serving a benign god.

pieces.name: Gammoth Mail
pieces.desc:
Armor worn by a warrior who
bravely faced a wrathful
god in battle.

pieces.name: Gammoth Braces
pieces.desc:
Armor worn to the very end
by the warriors that lost to
a wrathful god in battle.

pieces.name: Gammoth Faulds
pieces.desc:
Armor made from the despair
of a god seeing his warriors
lost in battle before him.

pieces.name: Gammoth Greaves
pieces.desc:
Created to honor a brave
warrior who exacted revenge
against an evil god.

pieces.name: Gammoth Cap
pieces.desc:
An ornamental helmet thought
to have been worn by warriors
serving a benign god.

pieces.name: Gammoth Vest
pieces.desc:
Armor worn by a warrior who
bravely faced a wrathful
god in battle.

pieces.name: Gammoth Guards
pieces.desc:
Armor worn to the very end
by the warriors that lost to
a wrathful god in battle.

pieces.name: Gammoth Coat
pieces.desc:
Armor made from the despair
of a god seeing his warriors
lost in battle before him.

pieces.name: Gammoth Leggings
pieces.desc:
Created to honor a brave
warrior who exacted revenge
against an evil god.

pieces.name: Gammoth Helm
pieces.desc:
Ornamental wear thought to
have been worn by maidens
comforting a benign god.

pieces.name: Gammoth Mail
pieces.desc:
Clothes worn by a maiden who
sacrificed herself to a
wrathful god from abroad.

pieces.name: Gammoth Braces
pieces.desc:
Sleeves of a maiden who
was the sole survivor of an
attack by a wrathful god.

pieces.name: Gammoth Faulds
pieces.desc:
A garment woven from the
despair of a god seeing his
last maiden torn asunder.

pieces.name: Gammoth Greaves
pieces.desc:
Worn by a great maiden
warrior who exacted revenge
against a wrathful god.

pieces.name: Gammoth Cap
pieces.desc:
Ornamental wear thought to
have been worn by maidens
comforting a benign god.

pieces.name: Gammoth Vest
pieces.desc:
Clothes worn by a maiden who
sacrificed herself to a
wrathful god from abroad.

pieces.name: Gammoth Guards
pieces.desc:
Sleeves of a maiden who
was the sole survivor of an
attack by a wrathful god.

pieces.name: Gammoth Coat
pieces.desc:
A garment woven from the
despair of a god seeing his
last maiden torn asunder.

pieces.name: Gammoth Leggings
pieces.desc:
Worn by a great maiden
warrior who exacted revenge
against a wrathful god.

pieces.name: Glavenus Helm
pieces.desc:
As sharp as any blade, this
helmet is capable of slicing
careless hands to shreds.

pieces.name: Glavenus Mail
pieces.desc:
Wrapping the body in flames,
this armor frightens friend
and foe alike.

pieces.name: Glavenus Braces
pieces.desc:
Vambraces with the spirit of
a blade. Foes kneel with a
wave of your hand.

pieces.name: Glavenus Faulds
pieces.desc:
Those that wear this armor in
battle are assured of victory
over their opponent.

pieces.name: Glavenus Greaves
pieces.desc:
Jet black nails rip through
deceit and cowardice as they
advance upon their prey.

pieces.name: Glavenus Cap
pieces.desc:
Forged in the fires of hell,
the design is as contorted
as its wearer's soul.

pieces.name: Glavenus Vest
pieces.desc:
Covering the upper body in
flames, it prepares the
wearer for the afterlife.

pieces.name: Glavenus Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards with the spirit of
a blade. Kingdoms fall with
a wave of your hand.

pieces.name: Glavenus Coat
pieces.desc:
Those that wear this armor in
battle are assured of endless
chaos and eternal honor.

pieces.name: Glavenus Leggings
pieces.desc:
Jet black nails rip through
resignation and nihilism as
they advance upon their prey.

pieces.name: Gore Helm
pieces.desc:
Black head armor that pulses
with ruinous power worthy of
the Gore Magala's undoer.

pieces.name: Gore Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor mantled in
cursed claws that draw prey
into a deadly miasma.

pieces.name: Gore Braces
pieces.desc:
Jet black armguards that can
seize even the largest prey
and draw it into oblivion.

pieces.name: Gore Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor that darkens
the world and seduces prey
toward certain demise.

pieces.name: Gore Greaves
pieces.desc:
Netherworld leg armor that
spirits you across hunting
grounds as fast as the wind.

pieces.name: Gore Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor given to the Gore
Magala's undoer. Doom wakens
with a glint of its eyes.

pieces.name: Gore Vest
pieces.desc:
The nightmarish Gore Magala
in chest armor form. Elicits
despair in all one's prey.

pieces.name: Gore Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards given to the Gore
Magala's slayer. They quiet
all thoughts of mercy.

pieces.name: Gore Coat
pieces.desc:
Shadowy, wing-like waist
armor. Scatters hostile
blows to the nether-winds.

pieces.name: Gore Leggings
pieces.desc:
Netherworld leg armor whose
footsteps across hell make
the candle of life flicker.

pieces.name: Regios Helm
pieces.desc:
A shining army raises a thousand
swords and returns home,
resplendent in the morning sun.

pieces.name: Regios Mail
pieces.desc:
A shining army sharpens a
thousand fangs and emerges from
the heated battle as victors.

pieces.name: Regios Vambraces
pieces.desc:
A shining army raises a thousand
claws to the sun as they
celebrate their newfound glory.

pieces.name: Regios Tassets
pieces.desc:
A shining army raises a thousand
banners and brings their conquest
to the ends of the earth.

pieces.name: Regios Greaves
pieces.desc:
A shining army performs a
thousand feats and walks
the path to glory.

pieces.name: Regios Cap
pieces.desc:
A golden army dons a thousand
crowns before carrying out its
sublime task.

pieces.name: Regios Vest
pieces.desc:
A golden army swears a thousand
oaths to their goddess before
charging into heaven's fray.

pieces.name: Regios Guards
pieces.desc:
A golden army catches the sun
upon their thousand shields as
they solidify their victory.

pieces.name: Regios Coat
pieces.desc:
A golden army drapes the world in
a thousand veils, bringing
heaven's peace to all the land.

pieces.name: Regios Leggings
pieces.desc:
A golden army leads a thousand
peoples to a land of new
beginnings.

pieces.name: Tigrex Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from Tigrex
parts. It crowns the wearer
a force of ruin.

pieces.name: Tigrex Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from Tigrex
parts. Only one who tames
the beast may claim it.

pieces.name: Tigrex Braces
pieces.desc:
Tigrex armor with fiendishly
brutal strength that is
completely otherworldly.

pieces.name: Tigrex Tassets
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Tigrex
parts. Trust your life to
its capable claws.

pieces.name: Tigrex Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made from Tigrex
parts. Every step makes the
ground cry out in pain.

pieces.name: Tigrex Cap
pieces.desc:
Head armor made from Tigrex
parts. Its wearer has
abolished fear itself.

pieces.name: Tigrex Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor with a lingering
scent of destruction. All who
see it are overcome with fear.

pieces.name: Tigrex Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from Tigrex
parts. Allow wearers to
cow prey into submission.

pieces.name: Tigrex Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Tigrex
parts. To wear it is to
conquer fear itself.

pieces.name: Tigrex Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made of Tigrex parts.
Like the tyrant, it exudes
earth-pulverizing power.

pieces.name: Kirin Horn
pieces.desc:
The awe-inspiring power of the
blue horn causes all who see
it to bend the knee.

pieces.name: Kirin Jacket
pieces.desc:
Armor knitted with Thunder
torn from heaven. Catches every
attack in a corona of light.

pieces.name: Kirin Longarms
pieces.desc:
Pale blue guards. Make
weapons appear more majestic,
as if clothed in lightning.

pieces.name: Kirin Hoop
pieces.desc:
Waist armor of the thunder god.
Focuses energy and increases
the wearer's power tenfold.

pieces.name: Kirin Leg Guards
pieces.desc:
Thunderous leg guards
surrounded by a magnetic
field that repels attacks.

pieces.name: Kirin Crest
pieces.desc:
Head armor with the power of
a thunder beast. The bearer
will come to know Truth.

pieces.name: Kirin Cape
pieces.desc:
A garment that glows in the
darkest of night. Come too close
and face its thunderous wrath.

pieces.name: Kirin Gloves
pieces.desc:
Silver gloves of lightning.
Weapons gripped with these
appear to radiate a noble light.

pieces.name: Kirin Shorts
pieces.desc:
Sacred armor forged with
lightning. The thunder god
protects the mind and body.

pieces.name: Kirin Boots
pieces.desc:
Boots capable of running a
thousand miles. They touch
the wind, not the earth.

pieces.name: Brachydios Helm
pieces.desc:
Head armor with the strength of a
Brachydios. Whoever wears it can
face explosions without fear.

pieces.name: Brachydios Mail
pieces.desc:
Chest armor with the strength of
a Brachydios. It contains a living
spark that burns all in its path.

pieces.name: Brachydios Braces
pieces.desc:
Armguards with the strength of
a Brachydios. They leave pale
white trails whenever swung.

pieces.name: Brachydios Faulds
pieces.desc:
Waist armor with the strength of
a Brachydios. It shines both
dark and pale in the light.

pieces.name: Brachydios Greaves
pieces.desc:
Leg armor with the strength of a
Brachydios. Of such power that
each step wears away the ground.

pieces.name: Brachydios Cap
pieces.desc:
Headgear with the strength of a
Brachydios. It grants fiery
power to every shot fired.

pieces.name: Brachydios Vest
pieces.desc:
Chest armor with the strength of
a Brachydios. Designed to absorb
the shock of most attacks.

pieces.name: Brachydios Guards
pieces.desc:
Armguards with the strength of
a Brachydios. They protect
Gunners' precious hands.

pieces.name: Brachydios Coat
pieces.desc:
Waist armor with the strength of
a Brachydios. Gunners like its
layered design.

pieces.name: Brachydios Leggings
pieces.desc:
Leg armor with the strength of a
Brachydios. Lightweight but tough,
it is ideal for extended battles.

pieces.name: Arc Helm
pieces.desc:
Heavenly, iridescent head
armor embodying the domain
of the Shagaru Magala.

parts. Striking it is more likely

pieces.desc:

parts. Their powerful appearance
hints at their true strength.

pieces.desc:
Armor made with Gravios parts.
Its thickness and weight are
indicative of its defensive power.

pieces.name: Gravios Greaves X
pieces.desc:
Greaves made from Gravios
parts. Tightly fastened to
protect like a castle gate.

pieces.name: Gravios Cap X
pieces.desc:
Cap made from Gravios
materials. Simply wearing it
is proof of one's valor.

pieces.name: Gravios Vest X
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from Gravios
parts. Crafted to value elemental
resistance over Defense.

pieces.name: Gravios Guards X
pieces.desc:

materials. Large, but they
will not hamper movement.

pieces.name: Gravios Coat X
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from Gravios
parts. Said to be strong enough
to crack a stone floor.

pieces.name: Gravios Leggings X
pieces.desc:

materials. Wearers' legs are
as strong as solid stone.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Helm X
pieces.desc:
A majestic, fragrant
headdress, replete with a
fleeting noble beauty.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Mail X
pieces.desc:
Clothing tailored to extol
the glory of the wedded
couple for all eternity.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Braces X
pieces.desc:
Ceremonial wear for the
hands, representing
generations of prosperity.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Faulds X
pieces.desc:
Attire worn by a benevolent
emperor who never gave up
believing in his people.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Greaves X
pieces.desc:
Brilliant footwear worn by
lords who stepped forth into
an illustrious golden age.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Mask X
pieces.desc:
A mask that smells of fried
tofu, for travelers willing
to brave the elements.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Vest X
pieces.desc:
An ethereal feathered gown
that beguiles all. Deception
is a prime hunting tactic.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Guards X
pieces.desc:
Thickly woven hand guards
meant for long journeys.
Snack pockets included.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Coat X
pieces.desc:
A feather-light costume with
such mobility that one may
hunt tirelessly for days.

pieces.name: Mizutsune Leggings X
pieces.desc:
Leggings capable of carrying
you great distances. The
paws have been concealed.

Those that wear the Astalos
on their head trade kindness
for a traitor's degeneracy.

pieces.name: Astalos Mail X
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the Astalos
on their body trade virtue
for a traitor's barbarity.

pieces.name: Astalos Braces X
pieces.desc:

on their arms trade innocence
for a traitor's malice.

pieces.name: Astalos Faulds X
pieces.desc:

for a traitor's rancor.

Those that wear the Astalos

for a traitor's treachery.

pieces.name: Astalos Leggings X
pieces.desc:
Those that wear the Astalos
on their legs choose disdain
over love.

Those permitted to touch
this bladed helm gain the
power to shred all things.

pieces.name: Glavenus Mail X
pieces.desc:
One can but cower in terror
at the sight of a warrior
clad in this infernal armor.

pieces.name: Glavenus Braces X
pieces.desc:
Vambraces with the spirit of
a blade, tempered many times
over, as is the hunter way.

pieces.name: Glavenus Faulds X
pieces.desc:
This armor proves the might
of the warrior who triumphs
after endless bloodshed.

pieces.name: Glavenus Greaves X
pieces.desc:
Even after all is turned to

pieces.name: Glavenus Cap X
pieces.desc:
Those permitted to wear this
bladed helm gain the power

pieces.name: Glavenus Vest X
pieces.desc:
One can but swear allegiance

infernal attire.

pieces.name: Glavenus Guards X

Vambraces with the spirit of

pieces.name: Glavenus Coat X

pieces.name: Glavenus Leggings X

pieces.desc:
Head armor made from lava-coated
Agnaktor parts. Marks the owner
as one who bested the lava king.

pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from lava-coated
Agnaktor parts. Makes lava founts
feel like a warm bath.

pieces.name: Agnaktor Vambraces X
pieces.desc:

Agnaktor parts. Good for taking

pieces.name: Agnaktor Faulds X
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from lava-coated
Agnaktor parts. The lava on its

pieces.name: Agnaktor Greaves X
pieces.desc:

Agnaktor parts. Perfect for a

pieces.name: Agnaktor Cap X
pieces.desc:

pieces.name: Agnaktor Vest X
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made from lava-coated
Agnaktor parts. Resembles the
flame god of a southern land.

pieces.name: Agnaktor Guards X
pieces.desc:
Armguards made from lava-coated
Agnaktor parts. Good for those
who would swiftly ready arrows.

pieces.name: Agnaktor Coat X
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made from lava-coated
Agnaktor parts. Grants protection

pieces.name: Agnaktor Leggings X
pieces.desc:

Agnaktor parts. Often used by

pieces.desc:
A king's head armor. It glows
with a mad, pitiless light, and
seeks to bring down heaven.

pieces.name: Gore Mail X
pieces.desc:

Magala's lingering miasma -- its

pieces.name: Gore Braces X

pieces.name: Gore Faulds X

pieces.name: Gore Greaves X
pieces.desc:

one's dark soul to this world.

pieces.name: Gore Cap X
pieces.desc:
A king's head armor. Whosoever
meets its eyes shall be dragged
into an inescapable nightmare.

pieces.name: Gore Vest X
pieces.desc:
Chest armor that flutters like
the darkness, casting an ominous
shadow over the midnight sun.

pieces.name: Gore Guards X
pieces.desc:
The arms of a conqueror, stained
in darkness. Prey are stripped of
hope and judged without mercy.

pieces.name: Gore Coat X
pieces.desc:
Waist armor like the Gore
Magala's darkness that stains the
earth and blurs its borders.

pieces.name: Gore Leggings X
pieces.desc:
Netherworld leg armor whose

to bubble up from below.

pieces.desc:
A shining army raises a thousand
swords and returns home,
resplendent in the morning sun.

pieces.name: Regios Mail X
pieces.desc:
A shining army sharpens a
thousand fangs and emerges from
the heated battle as victors.

pieces.name: Regios Vambraces X
pieces.desc:
A shining army raises a thousand
claws to the sun as they
celebrate their newfound glory.

pieces.name: Regios Tassets X
pieces.desc:
A shining army raises a thousand
banners and brings their conquest
to the ends of the earth.

pieces.name: Regios Greaves X
pieces.desc:
A shining army performs a
thousand feats and walks
the path to glory.

pieces.name: Regios Cap X
pieces.desc:
A golden army dons a thousand
crowns before carrying out its
sublime task.

pieces.name: Regios Vest X
pieces.desc:
A golden army swears a thousand
oaths to their goddess before
charging into heaven's fray.

pieces.name: Regios Guards X
pieces.desc:
A golden army catches the sun
upon their thousand shields as
they solidify their victory.

pieces.name: Regios Coat X
pieces.desc:
A golden army drapes the world in
a thousand veils, bringing
heaven's peace to all the land.

pieces.name: Regios Leggings X
pieces.desc:
A golden army leads a thousand
peoples to a land of new
beginnings.

pieces.desc:
Headgear made of the finest
Duramboros horn. Even a direct
wyvern strike won't scratch it.

pieces.name: Duramboros Mail X
pieces.desc:
Chest armor made of the finest
Duramboros horn. Wraps a hunter
in sturdy armor plating.

pieces.name: Duramboros Braces X
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of fine Duramboros
parts. Some say a hunter knocked

Waist armor made of the finest
Duramboros parts. The solid
shape enables powerful slashes.

pieces.name: Duramboros Greaves X
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made of the finest
Duramboros parts. Strong enough
to withstand fierce attacks.

pieces.name: Duramboros Cap X
pieces.desc:
Headgear made of the finest
Duramboros horn. It could
smash through solid rock.

pieces.name: Duramboros Vest X
pieces.desc:
Chest armor of fine Duramboros
horn. Great safety gear for
weapons with extreme firepower.

pieces.name: Duramboros Guards X
pieces.desc:
Armguards made of fine Duramboros
parts. Only master hunters can
handle all the added weight.

pieces.name: Duramboros Coat X
pieces.desc:
Waist armor made of the finest
Duramboros parts. The solid
shape enables powerful strikes.

pieces.name: Duramboros Leggings X
pieces.desc:
Leg armor made of the finest
Duramboros parts. Offers firm
bracing while one fires.

pieces.desc:
The Tigrex's heaven-shaking roar
in armor form. Its unrivaled strength
commands attention and respect.

pieces.name: Tigrex Mail X
pieces.desc:
The Tigrex's heart-pounding
passion. His blood pulses through
hunters, stirring their courage.

pieces.name: Tigrex Vambraces X
pieces.desc:
The Tigrex's anger in armor form.
His forelimbs split the earth and
render his realm a wasteland.

pieces.name: Tigrex Tassets X
pieces.desc:
The Tigrex's indignation in armor
form. It festers in his belly and
ends any fool who dares to face him.

pieces.name: Tigrex Greaves X
pieces.desc:
The Tigrex's gait in armor form.
Savage claws gouge the earth and
leave vicious records of his reign.

pieces.name: Tigrex Cap X
pieces.desc:
Armor made from a beast whose

grass to bow in fear.

pieces.name: Tigrex Vest X
pieces.desc:

the heart, which commands prey
be killed with each pulse.

pieces.name: Tigrex Guards X
pieces.desc:
Anger that tears through all
living things like so much flesh,
laying their habitat to waste.

pieces.name: Tigrex Coat X
pieces.desc:
Deep-seated indignation befitting
one of such kingly power. No foe
can quell it -- or survive it.

pieces.name: Tigrex Leggings X

heard via peals of lightning.

like bolts from the blue.

protection. Lighting answers
one's prayers with solemn power.

sacred Kirin walks. Pure prayers
light its path to a phantom land.

pieces.name: Kirin Crest X
pieces.desc:
Horns worn by a clan who worship
the Kirin. At their will, savage
beasts bow their heads.

pieces.name: Kirin Cape X
pieces.desc:

about the chest; its divine
clouds breathe heaven's will.

pieces.name: Kirin Gloves X
pieces.desc:

twin arms; heaven rewards their
devotion with blinding radiance.

pieces.name: Kirin Shorts X
pieces.desc:
Waist wear blessed with Kirin
protection. Its lightning storms
bestow triumphant power.

pieces.name: Kirin Boots X

pieces.name: Chaos Helm
pieces.desc:
Temptation comes to the one who
dons this helm. The twin horns
quietly await the time of judgment.

pieces.desc:
Armor that presides over doubt
and certainty. Will its wings take
one closer to clarity, or chaos?

pieces.name: Chaos Vambraces
pieces.desc:

liberty. Will the wearer be
haunted or healed by their dreams?

pieces.name: Chaos Faulds
pieces.desc:
Presides over falsehood and
truth. Will the scales favor
the accused, or damn him?

pieces.name: Chaos Greaves
pieces.desc:
Presides over hardship and
relief. Will the wearer go in
search of more trials, or rest?

pieces.name: Chaos Cap
pieces.desc:
Armor of darkness and light.
Will its eyes see a ray of light,
or merely emptiness?

pieces.name: Chaos Vest
pieces.desc:
Presides over distress and peace.
Will the two tangled hearts rebel 
or reach resolution?

pieces.name: Chaos Guards
pieces.desc:
Presides over iniquity and purity. 
Will the chains of sin be cast off 
or tightened further?

pieces.name: Chaos Coat
pieces.desc:
Presides over sorrow and joy.
Will the soul's cradle tilt
toward light, or shadow?

pieces.name: Chaos Leggings
pieces.desc:
Presides over dusk and dawn.
Will the wearer go with the
light, or wander into darkness?

pieces.desc:

pieces.name: Grand Divine Ire Haori
pieces.desc:
A great figure's chest armor.
Its ire spreads like golden wings
that bear it toward the heavens.

pieces.name: Grand Divine Ire Kote
pieces.desc:
A great figure's armguards.
Their rage waits to welcome fools
into a deadly, golden embrace.

pieces.name: Grand Divine Ire Obi
pieces.desc:
A great figure's waist armor.
Its fury obliterates prey as
casually as a bolt of lightning.

pieces.name: Grand Divine Ire Hakama
pieces.desc:
A great figure's leg armor.
Its enmity banishes all foes who
try to wade in its golden tide.

pieces.desc:

pieces.name: Grand Crusher Garb
pieces.desc:

pieces.name: Grand Crusher Braces

pieces.name: Grand Crusher Belt

pieces.desc:

denied. The ravenous owner of
this will devour all, laughing.

pieces.name: Esurient Mail Z
pieces.desc:

denied. This ravenous tyrant
dismisses even its own pain.

pieces.name: Esurient Vambraces Z
pieces.desc:
Let pain be extolled, survival
denied. This ravenous demon eats
only so it can hunger more.

pieces.name: Esurient Faulds Z
pieces.desc:
Let misery be extolled, blessings
denied. This ravenous savage
rends flesh with no compunction.

pieces.name: Esurient Greaves Z
pieces.desc:
Let regret be extolled, fortune
denied. This ravenous brute
piles corpses mountain high.

pieces.name: Esurient Cap Z
pieces.desc:
Let horrors be lauded, courage
mocked. The ravenous owner of
this watches all, dark eyes ready.

pieces.name: Esurient Vest Z
pieces.desc:
Let terror be lauded, justice
mocked. This ravenous murderer
awaits with sharpened fangs.

pieces.name: Esurient Guards Z
pieces.desc:
Let agony be lauded, solace
mocked. This ravenous gear will
smash apart all in its path.

pieces.name: Esurient Coat Z
pieces.desc:
Let sorrow be lauded, pride
mocked. This ravenous villain
